description:
**Job Description:**


We are looking for a skilled HR manager to oversee all aspects of Human Resources practices and processes. You will support business needs and ensure the proper implementation of company strategy and objectives. The goal is to promote corporate values and enable business success through human resources management, including job design, recruitment, performance management, training \& development, employment cycle changes, talent management, and facilities management services.


Responsibilities:

* Enhances the organization's human resources by planning, implementing, and evaluating employee relations and human resources policies, programs, and practices.
* Maintains the work structure by updating job requirements and job descriptions for all positions.
* Supports organization staff by establishing and interviewing program; counselling managers on candidate selection; conducting and analyzing exit interviews; and recommending changes.
* Prepares employees for assignments by establishing and conducting orientation and training programs.
* Manages a pay plan by conducting periodic pay surveys; scheduling and conducting job evaluations; preparing pay budgets; monitoring and scheduling individual pay actions; and recommending, planning, and implementing pay structure revisions.

* Implements employee benefits programs and informs employees of benefits by studying and assessing benefit needs and trends; recommending benefit programs to management; directing the processing of benefit claims; obtaining and evaluating benefit contract bids; awarding benefit contracts; and designing and conducting educational programs on benefit programs.

title: People & Culture Manager
description:
**About Four Seasons:**

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world\-class employee experience and company culture.
  

  

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.


**About the location:**

Open since May 2019, in the information technology capital of India, Four Seasons Hotel Bengaluru at Embassy ONE provides a preferred address for both business and leisure travellers, and the highly personalized, anticipatory service that Four Seasons guests expect and value around the world. Designed to reflect a sense of its location, the Hotel’s design merges nature and architecture in an homage to Bengaluru’s reputation as the Garden City. Four Seasons Hotel Bengaluru at Embassy ONE is located in one of the city’s most dynamic development that includes Four Seasons Private Residences, premium grade office space, sophisticated retail, dining and entertainment.
**About the role**

The **People \& Culture Manager** is responsible for leading recruitment, employee relations, learning and development, benefits administration, HR operations, and compliance initiatives to support business objectives and enhance the employee experience. This role partners with department leaders to attract, develop, and retain top talent, oversee onboarding and training programs, manage HR reporting and workforce planning, and ensure compliance with employment laws and company policies. The People \& Culture Manager also drives employee engagement activities, supervises the HR team, administers employee benefits, and fosters a positive, inclusive, and high\-performance workplace culture.
**What you will do**

* As a strategic business partner, this role works closely with department leaders to foster a positive workplace culture, attract and retain top talent, ensure legal compliance, and deliver exceptional employee experiences aligned with organizational goals and values.
* Assume the responsibilities of recruitment for the Director of Human Resources in their absence.
* Supervise, train and counsel the team in their daily functions.
* Monitor and ensure compliance with the staffing procedures as it relates to job requisitions. Coordinate, administer and implement all employee personal files prior to commencement of their job. Ensure that accurate job descriptions, policies, corporate policies are signed and filed in respective HR file of the employee concerned.
* Produce monthly HR reports with the use of the Workday reports and distribute to respective Division Heads (e.g: turnover reports, promotions, new hires, salary comparisons, accidents, injuries, sick leave).
* Administer the Apprenticeship and Internship Program with the assistance of the Learning Manager.
* Participate in community recruiting events including job fairs, local colleges/university.
* Ensure the employee restaurant is clean, the food is well prepared and that there are appropriate decorations for holidays and special events.
* Ensure all employee medical and insurance benefits are administered accurately and employee claims are handled on a timely manner.
* Develop and maintain the job posting system internally and on the Four Seasons career watch and local website.
* Monitor whether accurate count of employee additions and deletions with back up for Insurance provider on a monthly basis and provide support to annual budget process regarding all benefit plans.
* Organize and maintain legally compliant records as applicable under but not limited to Shops \& Establishment Act, Employee Provident Fund Act, Employee State Insurance Act, Minimum Wages Act, Payment of Bonus Act, Payment of Gratuity Act etc. including all monthly, quarterly, semi\-annual and annual reports.
* Lead, coach, and develop the People \& Culture team.
* Provide guidance and support to managers on people\-related matters.
* Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Act as the People \& Culture lead in the absence of the Director of People \& Culture.

**What you bring**

* Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
* 8\-9 years of progressive HR experience, preferably within hospitality, luxury hotels, or customer\-focused organizations.
* Strong knowledge of recruitment, employee relations, learning and development, and employment legislation.
* Experience managing HR systems such as Workday or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of employment laws and HR best practices
* Professional HR certification is an advantage,

**What we offer:**

### **·****Competitive Salary, wages, and a comprehensive benefits package**

### **·****Excellent Training and Development opportunities including an international career.**

### **·****Complimentary Dream Holidays at other Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts**

### **·****Comprehensive Insurance coverage for Hospitalization and Personal Accident**

We actively participate in community health programs, awareness campaigns, and outreach activities to promote healthcare education and support underserved populations.  

  

As you join our team, we invite you to embody the values and culture of Apollo Hospitals. Together, we have the power to make a significant impact on the lives of our patients and contribute to the progress of healthcare in our community.  

  

We are excited about the opportunity to collaborate with you, harnessing your skills and expertise to deliver exceptional care and service to our patients. If you have any inquiries or would like to explore more about Apollo Hospitals, please don't hesitate to contact our team.  

  

Thank you for joining the Apollo Hospitals family. We are thrilled to begin this journey together, striving for excellence in healthcare.  

  

Sincerely,
Team HR

description:
At Infoblox, every breakthrough begins with a bold **“what if.”**

**What if** your ideas could ignite global innovation?


**What if** your curiosity could redefine the future?


We invite you to step into the next exciting chapter of **your** career journey. Bring your creativity, drive, your daring spirit, and feel what it’s like to thrive on a team big enough to make an impact, yet small enough to make a difference. Our cloud\-first networking and security solutions already protect **70% of the Fortune 500** , and we’re looking for creative thinkers ready to push that influence even further. Join us and discover how far your bold “what if” can take the world, your community, and your career.


How we empower our people is extraordinary: we’re recognized as a **Glassdoor Best Place to Work 2025, Great Place to Work\-Certified in five countries, and honored by Cigna as a Healthy Workforce honors for three consecutive years; and what we build is world class: named CybersecAsia’s Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024** — clear evidence that when first\-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So, what if the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? **Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next.”**

In a world where you can be anything, **Be Infoblox.**

**Senior HR Business Partner**

We have an opportunity for a **Senior HR Business Partner** to join our People \& Places (Human Resources) team in Bangalore, India, reporting to the Director, HR Business Partner. In this pivotal role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders in a global, matrixed environment—shaping people strategies that fuel growth, innovation, and a strong, inclusive culture. Collaborating closely with HR Centers of Excellence (Talent Development, Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, People Operations) and cross\-functional business stakeholders, you will drive data\- and AI\-informed people decisions, lead complex organizational change, and champion a compelling employee experience that helps every Bloxer do the best work of their career.


You will combine business acumen, data\-driven insights, and HR expertise, while ensuring strong regulatory compliance and ethical standards, to deliver impactful outcomes at scale. You will embody our values, acting with integrity and transparency, championing belonging and respect, and approaching every challenge with a growth mindset and collaborative spirit.


**Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do**

* Partner with senior business leaders as a strategic HR advisor to translate business objectives into integrated people plans across workforce planning, org design, talent, and culture
* Lead key people processes for assigned client groups, including performance cycles, talent reviews, succession planning, promotions, and organizational changes
* Use people data, dashboards, and AI\-driven insights (e.g., Oracle HCM analytics, HR reporting tools) to identify trends, risks, and opportunities and recommend business\-focused actions
* Coach managers and leaders on performance management, feedback, difficult conversations, and change leadership, enabling strong, high\-performing teams
* Manage complex employee relations matters with a fair, structured, and risk\-aware approach, in line with Infoblox policies and local labor laws
* Partner with HR COEs (Talent Development, Total Rewards, DEI, Talent Acquisition, HR Operations) to design, localize, and implement scalable HR programs
* Ensure compliance with Indian labor laws, internal policies, and global HR standards, maintaining audit readiness in partnership with Legal and People Operations
* Leverage AI and digital HR tools (e.g., AskHR chatbot, Oracle HCM, Microsoft 365/Power BI) to streamline workflows and enhance the employee and manager experience
* Translate market trends and workforce analytics into actionable recommendations on talent, internal mobility, organizational effectiveness, and future skills
* Foster a culture of psychological safety, inclusion, and bias\-toward\-action decision\-making, holding yourself and others accountable with transparency and care

**Be Prepared — What You Bring**

* 8\+ years of progressive HR experience, including HRBP partnership with senior leaders in a global, matrixed environment
* Proven ability to influence and align senior stakeholders, navigate ambiguity, and deliver results across competing priorities
* Strong expertise in employee relations, leadership coaching, organizational development, and change management
* Analytical mindset with experience using HR analytics, dashboards, and AI\-enabled insights (e.g., Oracle HCM, survey analytics) to inform decisions
* Demonstrated ability to build trusted, credible relationships across all levels of the organization
* Digital and AI fluency across HR and productivity platforms (Oracle HCM, ServiceNow/AskHR, Microsoft or Google suite)
* Strong knowledge of Indian employment law and HR best practices, with experience ensuring compliance while enabling business agility
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources or a related field; HR certifications (e.g., SHRM, CIPD, HR AI/IS, Project Management) are a plus

**Be Successful — Your Path**

First 90 Days: Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short/long term goals.


Six Months:


* Establish trusted partnerships with senior leaders and become a go\-to advisor on people, culture, and organizational topics
* Lead or materially shape performance, talent review, and succession planning cycles for your business areas, leveraging AI\-driven insights
* Improve key people metrics (attrition, internal mobility, engagement) through targeted action plans co\-created with business leaders
* Partner with HR COEs to localize and implement at least one major HR initiative for India with strong change management
* Deliver at least two process improvements that leverage digital or AI tools to reduce manual HR work and enhance employee experience

One Year:


* Be recognized as a strategic thought partner shaping the long\-term people agenda, workforce strategy, and org design for your business areas
* Demonstrate measurable impact on engagement, internal fill rates, regrettable attrition, and succession readiness through sustained programs
* Lead or co\-lead multi\-country or cross\-functional HR initiatives that improve process efficiency, governance, and employee experience at scale
* Embed AI\-enabled and data\-driven decision\-making into day\-to\-day people processes and mentor HR peers on effective use
* Champion a culture of inclusion and psychological safety with visible improvements in feedback, collaboration, and trust

**Belong —** Your Community


Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.


**Be Rewarded —** Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong


* Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options
* Learning opportunities, career\-mobility programs, and leadership workshops
* Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy
* Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks (and the occasional cupcake), plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations
* Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match

**Ready to Be the Difference?**

*Infoblox is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis*

**Preferred Skills** 




  





  




* Experience in the electronics, automotive, or connector manufacturing industry.
* Experience supporting a newly established entity in India from an HR setup perspective.



  





  





**Pay Range and Compensation Package** 




  





  





 Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience and qualifications. Opportunity to work in a dynamic, multinational environment with career development and growth opportunities within a fast\-growing global company.

title: Prompt Engineer
description:
Prompt Engineer (Fresher / Entry\-Level)

**Company:** Physiqo **Location:** \[ Remote ] **Experience:** 0–1 year (Freshers welcome) **Employment Type:** Part Time **Department:** AI / Product

About Physiqo

Physiqo is building AI\-powered health and fitness experiences that help people understand their bodies better and reach their fitness goals faster. We're a fast\-moving, product\-first team looking for curious, detail\-oriented people to help shape how our AI systems think, talk, and respond to users.

About the Role

As a Prompt Engineer at Physiqo, you'll design, test, and refine the prompts and instructions that power our AI features — from conversational coaching to personalized recommendations. You'll work closely with product, ML, and design teams to make sure our AI responses are accurate, safe, on\-brand, and genuinely helpful to users.

This is a great role for someone who loves language, logic, and problem\-solving, and wants to get hands\-on experience with large language models (LLMs) in a real product setting. No prior professional experience is required — we're looking for strong fundamentals and a fast learning curve.

What You'll Do

* Write, test, and iterate on prompts for LLM\-powered features (chat, recommendations, content generation, etc.)
* Break down user needs and product requirements into clear, structured prompt instructions
* Run systematic experiments to compare prompt variations and measure output quality
* Identify and fix failure modes — hallucinations, inconsistent tone, unsafe or irrelevant responses
* Build and maintain a library of reusable prompt templates and evaluation criteria
* Collaborate with engineers to integrate prompts into the product and set up feedback loops
* Analyze user interactions and outputs to spot patterns and suggest improvements
* Stay current with LLM capabilities, prompting techniques, and industry best practices
* Document your prompt designs, decisions, and learnings for the team

What We're Looking For

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Linguistics, English, Psychology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* Strong written English — clarity, precision, and structure in communication
* Genuine interest in AI/LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) — personal projects or experimentation count
* Basic understanding of how LLMs work (tokens, context windows, temperature, etc.) — or eagerness to learn quickly
* Analytical mindset — comfortable breaking problems into logical steps and testing hypotheses
* Basic familiarity with Python (helpful, not mandatory)
* Attention to detail and a habit of double\-checking edge cases
* Curiosity, patience, and comfort with iteration (a lot of prompt engineering is trial and error)

Nice to Have

* Experience using the OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google AI APIs (even personal projects)
* Familiarity with prompt frameworks (few\-shot, chain\-of\-thought, ReAct, etc.)
* Exposure to fitness, nutrition, or health\-tech domains
* Basic knowledge of data analysis tools (Excel, SQL, or Python/pandas)

What You'll Get

* Hands\-on experience building real AI products used by real users from day one
* Mentorship from experienced product and ML team members
* A steep learning curve in one of the fastest\-growing fields in tech

How to Apply

Send your resume along with:

* A short note on why you're interested in prompt engineering / AI
* (Optional but encouraged) Examples of prompts you've written or AI tools you've experimented with

**Apply at:** career@physiqo.in (Send you resume on this Email)

*Physiqo is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.*

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

description:
About Evergreen Solar:

Evergreen Solar is the best solar company in Eastern India, specializing in end\-to\-end EPC solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial solar projects. Committed to innovation and quality, we provide sustainable energy solutions that drive a greener future.

Job Summary:

The Maintenance Engineer will be responsible for the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of solar PV systems. The role includes conducting preventive and corrective maintenance, ensuring system uptime, and maintaining safety and quality standards.

Roles \& Responsibilities:

A. **Preventive \& Corrective Maintenance**

* Perform routine preventive and corrective maintenance of solar PV systems.
* Inspect solar panels, inverters, electrical equipment, and mounting structures regularly.
* Identify faults and carry out necessary repairs to minimize system downtime.
* Ensure optimum system performance through timely maintenance activities.

B. **Inspection \& Troubleshooting**

* Conduct periodic inspections of solar plants and identify technical issues.
* Diagnose electrical and mechanical faults in solar PV systems.
* Troubleshoot inverter, DC/AC wiring, and other system\-related issues.
* Replace or repair defective components as required.

C. **Performance Monitoring**

* Monitor daily system performance and energy generation.
* Analyze system data to identify performance deviations.
* Recommend corrective actions to improve plant efficiency.
* Maintain system uptime as per company standards.

D. **Site Safety \& Compliance**

* Follow company safety policies and standard operating procedures.
* Ensure proper use of PPE while carrying out maintenance work.
* Maintain compliance with electrical safety standards and industry regulations.
* Report unsafe conditions and implement corrective measures.

E. **Documentation \& Reporting**

* Maintain maintenance logs, service reports, and inspection records.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly maintenance reports.
* Record equipment history and maintenance schedules.
* Update maintenance records in the ERP or company database.

F. **Customer \& Team Coordination**

* Coordinate with clients regarding maintenance schedules and service activities.
* Work closely with project, installation, and technical support teams.
* Respond promptly to service requests and emergency breakdowns.
* Provide technical guidance to junior technicians when required.

G. **Additional Responsibilities**

* Conduct site visits for maintenance and inspection as assigned.
* Ensure proper housekeeping of the work area after maintenance activities.
* Support warranty claim processes for faulty equipment, if applicable.
* Perform any other duties assigned by the Management from time to time.

Required Qualifications:

Diploma/B.Tech/B.E. in Electrical Engineering, Electrical \& Electronics Engineering, or a related field.

Required Skills:

* Basic knowledge of **solar PV systems and electrical maintenance.**
* Understanding of **inverters, AC/DC systems, earthing, and protection devices**.
* Ability to **use electrical testing instruments** such as a multimeter, clamp meter, and insulation tester.
* Knowledge of **preventive maintenance practices**.
* Good **troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills**.
* Basic knowledge of **MS Office and report preparation**.
* **Willingness to travel to project sites and work in field environments.**

Preferred Experience

* Fresher or 1–3 years of experience in solar O\&M, electrical maintenance, or field service.

title: Data Scientist
description:
We are a fast\-growing startup based in Pune, India, specializing in cutting\-edge Data Science and Data Engineering solutions. Our team of dedicated professionals is committed to solving complex data challenges for companies worldwide.
 



  





**Our Culture** 




 We foster a vibrant startup culture that values:
 


* Intellectual curiosity
* Continuous learning
* Positive work environment
* Collaborative problem\-solving



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a versatile and proactive Data Scientist to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will possess a blend of technical expertise in modern AI/ML technologies, strategic planning, and effective communication skills. This role demands critical thinking, applying data science and problem\-solving skills to a wide variety of real\-world problems, adaptability to rapidly evolving technologies, and a strong foundation in both traditional and generative AI principles.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Deliver end\-to\-end data science projects by applying Machine Learning and Deep Learning fundamentals to solve complex problems
* Derive actionable insights for a variety of problems, industries, and domains using statistical analysis and advanced data science techniques
* Develop high\-quality software solutions with Python and other programming languages. Collaborate with developers to understand and improve existing code or create new solutions
* Build and deploy production\-ready LLM applications using modern frameworks and best practices
* Design and implement RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) architectures using vector databases and embedding models
* Perform prompt engineering and optimization to maximize LLM performance for specific use cases
* Implement agentic AI systems and multi\-agent workflows for complex automation tasks
* Evaluate and benchmark LLM outputs using appropriate metrics and testing frameworks
* Build sophisticated data pipelines for large\-scale data processing using modern orchestration tools
* Optimize database performance and create efficient SQL queries
* Deploy and monitor ML models in production using MLOps practices and containerization
* Practice active listening to understand project requirements and team inputs
* Collaborate with clients to translate business requirements into data science solutions
* Communicate complex ideas and results clearly to stakeholders through both verbal and written formats
* Apply responsible AI principles and ensure ethical considerations in model development
* Demonstrate punctuality and a strong sense of ownership in all tasks
* Plan strategically and multitask efficiently to meet project deadlines
* Employ critical thinking to break down problems and debug effectively
* Take initiative and be biased towards action to drive project progress



  





**Required Skills** 




  





**Core Programming \& ML** 



* Strong Python programming skills with hands\-on project experience
* Expertise in Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms (Random Forests, GBMs, Neural Networks, CNNs, RNNs, Transformers, Ensemble methods)
* Proficiency in TensorFlow or PyTorch, along with scikit\-learn and pandas
* Familiarity with modern ML techniques: Transfer Learning, Few\-shot Learning, Self\-supervised Learning
* Experience with NLP, Computer Vision, or Time Series Analysis



  





**Generative AI \& LLMs** 



* Hands\-on experience with LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or open\-source models)
* Proficiency with GenAI orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or DSPy)
* Experience building RAG applications with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS)
* Strong prompt engineering skills and understanding of prompt optimization techniques
* Knowledge of fine\-tuning techniques (LoRA, QLoRA) and when to apply them
* Understanding of LLM evaluation metrics and benchmarking methodologies
* Familiarity with agentic AI architectures and multi\-agent systems



  





**MLOps \& Deployment** 



* Experience with MLOps practices and tools (MLflow, Kubeflow, Weights \& Biases)
* Proficiency with containerization using Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for ML model deployment and monitoring
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines for ML applications
* Knowledge of model serving frameworks and API development (FastAPI, Flask, or Django)



  





**Data Engineering \& Databases** 



* Solid understanding of SQL, including advanced concepts like windowing functions and query optimization
* Experience with data pipeline orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect, or similar)
* Familiarity with both SQL and NoSQL databases



  





**Soft Skills \& Professional Attributes** 



* Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities
* Demonstrated ability to work well in a team and independently
* High degree of flexibility and adaptability to rapidly evolving technologies
* Understanding of AI safety principles and responsible AI practices



  





**Nice\-to\-Have** 



* Experience with big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop, Databricks)
* Familiarity with BI tools and dashboard creation (Tableau, Power BI, Looker)
* Knowledge of graph databases and knowledge graph construction
* Experience with real\-time streaming data processing
* Active participation in data science competitions (Kaggle, DrivenData)
* Contributions to open\-source AI/ML projects or technical blog
* Experience with multimodal AI models (vision\-language models, audio processing)
* Published research papers or conference presentations



  





**Qualifications** 



* Data Scientist : Minimum 3 years of hands\-on experience in Data Science projects
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or related technical field
* Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning through courses, certifications, or self\-study (especially in GenAI and modern ML techniques)



  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive salary commensurate with experience
* Opportunity to work on diverse, cutting\-edge AI/ML projects
* Collaborative and innovation\-driven work environment
* Rapid growth and continuous learning opportunities
* Exposure to latest AI technologies and industry best practices

title: Production Intern
description:
**About ETOS Technology Private Limited**

ETOS Technology Private Limited is an emerging electric vehicle (EV) manufacturing company specializing in the design and production of innovative low\-speed electric two\-wheelers. Our mission is to build reliable, efficient, and affordable electric mobility solutions through advanced engineering and quality manufacturing.

We are looking for enthusiastic interns who are passionate about manufacturing and electric vehicles and are eager to gain practical industry experience on the production floor.

**Job Summary**

The Production \& Shop Floor Intern will work closely with the Production Team and assist in daily manufacturing activities. This role provides hands\-on exposure to assembly, fabrication, inventory handling, quality inspection, machine operations, and production planning.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in day\-to\-day shop floor manufacturing activities.
* Support assembly and fabrication of products and components.
* Help maintain production records and daily activity logs.
* Assist in inventory management and material movement.
* Support quality inspection of manufactured parts.
* Ensure tools and workstations are organized and clean.
* Follow production schedules assigned by the Production Supervisor.
* Assist in packaging and dispatch preparation.
* Learn and follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Adhere to workplace safety regulations and use PPE at all times.
* Report production issues or defects to the supervisor.
* Assist in continuous improvement and 5S implementation activities.

**Eligibility**

* Diploma or ITI students/graduates in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing, Automobile, Electrical, Mechatronics, or related fields.
* Final\-year engineering students are also encouraged to apply.
* Freshers are welcome.

**Required Skills**

* Basic understanding of manufacturing processes.
* Willingness to perform hands\-on shop floor work.
* Good observation and learning ability.
* Basic mechanical aptitude.
* Ability to work in a team.
* Positive attitude and discipline.
* Basic knowledge of hand tools and measuring instruments is an added advantage.

**What You'll Learn**

* Manufacturing and production processes
* Assembly techniques
* Quality control and inspection
* Inventory and material management
* Production planning basics
* Industrial safety practices
* Lean Manufacturing and 5S
* Documentation and reporting

**Working Hours**

* Monday to Saturday
* 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM

**Internship Benefits**

* Hands\-on industrial manufacturing experience
* Mentorship from experienced production engineers
* Internship Certificate upon successful completion
* Letter of Recommendation (based on performance)
* Opportunity for full\-time employment at ETOS Technology Private Limited based on performance

**Preferred Candidates**

* Passionate about manufacturing and engineering.
* Comfortable working in a production/shop floor environment.
* Physically fit to perform shop floor activities.
* Eager to learn and grow in the manufacturing industry.

Pay: ₹2,000\.00 \- ₹5,000\.00 per month

title: Software Tester Intern
description:
**Job Summary:**  
We are looking for a motivated and skilled Test Automation Engineer to join our quality assurance team. The ideal candidate should have a passion for technology, a keen eye for detail, and a basic understanding of automated testing processes. The candidate will work closely with developers and testers to automate test cases, improve software quality, and ensure smooth product releases. Freshers or candidates with up to 6 months of relevant experience are welcome to apply.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Test Automation Development:**

* Develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts using tools like Selenium, JUnit, TestNG, or similar.
* Collaborate with the development and testing teams to understand the functionality and design effective automated test cases.
* Ensure test scripts are scalable, maintainable, and reusable across different testing scenarios.

**Test Execution \& Reporting:**

* Execute automated tests and report test results to identify defects and improvements.
* Log and track defects in a test management tool (e.g., Jira) and ensure they are addressed in a timely manner.
* Continuously monitor and improve automation test coverage to ensure efficiency and accuracy.
* **Collaboration \& Feedback:**
* Work closely with developers to analyze test results, troubleshoot issues, and propose improvements.
* Provide feedback and suggestions for software quality improvements based on test results and automated test executions.

**Documentation \& Reporting:**

* Maintain clear and detailed documentation for test cases, test scripts, and test execution results.
* Prepare and present regular reports on test automation progress and quality metrics.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

**Educational Background:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

**Key Skills \& Competencies:**

* Basic knowledge of automation testing tools (e.g., Selenium, JUnit, TestNG).
* Understanding of programming languages such as Java, Python, JavaScript, or C\#.
* Familiarity with version control systems like Git.
* Ability to write and maintain clear, effective, and efficient test scripts.
* Knowledge of software development life cycle (SDLC) and agile methodology.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

**Technical Proficiency:**

* Proficiency in using test automation tools and frameworks.
* Experience with continuous integration tools like Jenkins is a plus.
* Basic understanding of API testing and automation tools like Postman or REST Assured is an advantage.

**Personal Attributes:**

* Self\-motivated, target\-driven, and a fast learner.
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
* Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively.

description:
QA Manual Tester (Fresher / Intern)About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated, detail\-oriented, and **Self\-Driven QA Manual Tester Fresher** to join our team for a **6\-month internship/full\-time conversion program**. In this role, you will play a crucial part in ensuring the quality, performance, and seamless user experience of our **Job Portal \& EdTech Platforms**.

If you are passionate about building seamless career and learning experiences, love finding hidden bugs, and thrive in a fast\-paced environment with minimal supervision, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

* **Test Execution:** Perform end\-to\-end manual testing across our Job Portal and EdTech ecosystems (Web, Responsive Mobile Web, and Mobile Apps).
* **Bug Tracking:** Identify, document, and track software defects thoroughly using bug\-tracking tools (e.g., Jira). Provide clear reproduction steps, logs, and screenshots.
* **Test Case Creation:** Assist in writing and updating comprehensive test cases and test scenarios based on product workflows and requirements.
* **Functional \& UI Testing:** Verify core workflows such as user registration/profiles, resume parsing, job application pipelines, payment gateways, video course playback, and interactive quizzes.
* **Regression Testing:** Conduct regression testing cycles before major platform releases to ensure existing features remain unbroken.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with developers and product managers to understand feature requirements and expedite bug resolutions.

What We Are Looking For

* **Education \& Experience:** Fresher with a degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field (or equivalent practical knowledge/certification in software testing).
* **Domain Interest:** Familiarity with the mechanics of online job boards and learning management systems (LMS).
* **Core Skills:** Solid foundational knowledge of the software development life cycle (SDLC) and software testing life cycle (STLC).
* **Self\-Driven Mindset:** A proactive problem\-solver who can take ownership of tasks and figure things out with minimal guidance.
* **Attention to Detail:** An analytical eye capable of spotting subtle UI glitches, broken application flows, or data inconsistencies.
* **Communication:** Clear verbal and written communication skills to articulate technical issues effectively to the development team.

What We Offer

* **Stipend:** Competitive internship stipend.
* **Career Growth:** A direct pathway to a full\-time employment contract within 6 months based on performance and impact.
* **Hands\-on Experience:** Real\-world exposure to testing high\-traffic web applications, complex databases, and interactive learning features.
* **Mentorship:** Direct guidance from experienced QA professionals and engineering leaders to help fast\-track your technical growth.

description:

Bengaluru, IN
  
  

**Company:** Getinge Medical India Pvt. Ltd.
  
**Remote Work:** Field
  
  

With a passion for life
  
  

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life\-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
  
  

Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.
  
  

Job Overview
  
  

The Respiratory Therapist Specialist – Apprentice program is designed for fresh graduates aspiring to build a career in respiratory care and mechanical ventilation technology. As part of a leading healthcare/medical device organization, the apprentice will receive intensive training on mechanical ventilators, CPAP/BiPAP systems, and other respiratory care devices while supporting clinical teams in hospitals.
  
  

This is a structured learning role with strong exposure to real\-world clinical workflows, device handling, and interaction with ICU/critical care staff.
  
  

Job Responsibilities and Essential Duties
  
  

Clinical \& Technical Learning
  
  

Learn the fundamentals of mechanical ventilation, respiratory parameters, and device operations.
  
Assist senior respiratory therapists and application specialists during ventilator demonstrations, installations, and clinical support sessions.
  
Observe and assist with ventilator setup, configuration, and monitoring in ICU, NICU, PICU, and emergency settings.
  
Understand different ventilation modes (e.g., Volume Control, Pressure Control, SIMV, CPAP).
  
  

Application \& Customer Support
  
  

Support in conducting product demos and hands\-on training for clinicians and nurses.
  
Assist in troubleshooting basic device issues under guidance from senior team members.
  
Learn how to document feedback, clinical observations, and usage patterns from hospitals.
  
  

Device Management \& Compliance
  
  

Help in performing routine checks, preventive maintenance, and performance assessments of ventilators.
  
Ensure proper cleaning, handling, and safety protocols for all respiratory devices.
  
Follow company SOPs, regulatory guidelines, and hospital infection control norms.
  
  

Training \& Certification
  
  

Participate in structured internal training programs on respiratory therapy and ventilator technology.
  
Complete skill assessments, modules, and certification milestones during the apprenticeship period.
  
  

Minimum Requirements
  
  

**Education (Freshers Only):** Bachelor’s Degree in: Respiratory Therapy / Respiratory Care
  
  

**Preferred Knowledge:**  

Basic understanding of Human Respiratory physiology
  
Interest in mechanical ventilation and critical care devices
  
Comfort working in hospital/ICU environments
  
  

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  
  

Strong learning mindset and passion for respiratory care
  
Good communication and interpersonal skills for hospital interactions
  
Technical curiosity for medical devices and technology
  
Ability to work under supervision in fast paced clinical settings
  
Willingness to travel locally for hospital visits
  
  

Benefits \& Growth Opportunities
  
  

Hands\-on training with advanced ventilator systems and respiratory technology
  
Exposure to real hospital environments, ICU workflows, and critical care teams
  
Mentorship from experienced respiratory therapists and application experts
  
Certificate of Apprenticeship upon completion
  
  

**Strong career pathway into:**  

Respiratory Therapist
  
Application Specialist – Ventilators
  
Clinical Specialist – Critical Care
  
Product Trainer / Clinical Educator
  
Technical Support Specialist (Medical Devices)
  
  

About the Apprenticeship Program
  
  

This apprenticeship is built to develop future\-ready respiratory care professionals who can operate confidently in critical care environments and support hospitals with advanced ventilator solutions. The program blends classroom learning, field exposure, and supervised clinical practice.
  
  

About us
  
  

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.
  
  

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

description:

We are looking for a hands\-on **Graphic Design Specialist** who can own design work end to end — from understanding the requirement and creating concepts to delivering final creatives across digital, print, product, and sales channels.

This role is ideal for someone who is creative, detail\-oriented, fast\-moving, and comfortable working in a startup environment where designs need to be built from scratch, improved continuously, and aligned with business goals.

**Role Overview**

The Graphic Design Specialist will be responsible for creating high\-quality visual assets for NetSense’s brand, products, website, social media, sales material, presentations, events, and internal communication.

The person should be able to understand technical products, convert them into clear visual communication, and create designs that make complex cybersecurity and networking concepts easy to understand.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Brand \& Visual Design**

* Create and maintain consistent visual branding across all NetSense materials.
* Design brand assets, templates, icons, illustrations, product graphics, banners, and campaign creatives.
* Ensure all designs follow NetSense’s brand style, colors, typography, and overall visual identity.
* Improve existing brand materials and create new visual systems where required.

**Digital \& Social Media Creatives**

* Design LinkedIn posts, carousels, social media banners, ad creatives, infographics, announcement posts, and campaign visuals.

**Website \& UI Visual Assets**

\- Set up and maintain LAN and WAN infrastructure

\- Manage and maintain VPN and access control systems; debug connectivity and authentication issues

\- Configure and support distributed setups (e.g., primary/mirror servers and multiple clients)

\- Install, configure, and test tools required for engineering teams and internal workflows

**Automation and Process Improvement**

description:
About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented **Procurement Executive** with experience in the architecture, interior design, and construction industry. The candidate should have a strong understanding of construction materials, interior finishes, vendor management, project procurement, and supply chain coordination. The role involves sourcing quality materials, managing vendors, maintaining procurement timelines, and ensuring cost\-effective purchasing for multiple projects.

Key Responsibilities

* Source and procure materials, equipment, and services for architectural, interior, and construction projects.

* Research suppliers, and market trends to improve quality, reduce costs, and optimize procurement strategies.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Interior Design, Construction Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.

title: Python Developer Intern
description:
Based on current job postings across India for **Python/Django Interns**, companies looking to hire emerging developers typically require a specific mix of core programming skills, backend familiarity, and practical tools.

To help you design a curriculum that gets your students hired or to write an attractive job description to hire one yourself, here is what the industry actually expects from a Python/Django intern.

Technical Skills RequiredCore Python Programming

Interns aren't expected to know everything about architecture, but they must be completely comfortable with writing clean, functional Python.

* **Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP):** Solid grip on classes, inheritance, and functions.
* **Data Structures:** Mastery over lists, dictionaries, tuples, sets, and basic algorithms.
* **Virtual Environments:** Ability to use venv or virtualenv to manage package dependencies cleanly.

Django \& Backend Web Development

* **MVT Architecture:** Understanding Model\-View\-Template pattern and how data flows through a Django app.
* **Django ORM \& Databases:** Ability to write database queries using Python code instead of raw SQL, write migrations (makemigrations, migrate), and link tables (One\-to\-Many, Many\-to\-Many).
* **Django REST Framework (DRF):** Almost every Python web internship demands basic knowledge of REST APIs. Interns should know how to use **Serializers**, **APIViews/ViewSets**, and handle JSON data.
* **Authentication \& Security:** Familiarity with user login/registration flows, JWT (JSON Web Tokens), or session\-based authentication.

Essential Tools \& Infrastructure

* **Version Control (Git/GitHub):** The absolute \#1 requirement. Knowing how to branch, commit, push, and create pull requests without breaking the codebase.
* **Databases:** Hands\-on experience with **PostgreSQL** or **MySQL** (moving beyond just default local SQLite).
* **API Testing Tools:** Ability to test endpoints independently using **Postman** or **cURL**.

Soft Skills \& Daily Responsibilities

When companies hire Python/Django interns, their typical daily tasks include:

* **Writing \& Debugging Code:** Fixing small bugs in existing backend services or writing minor helper scripts.
* **API Integration:** Connecting the backend with third\-party APIs (like payment gateways, SMS providers, or AI models).
* **Collaborating with Frontend:** Working alongside React/Flutter developers by delivering clean JSON endpoints for them to consume.
* **Documentation:** Writing clear API docs and maintaining clean README.md files.

What Makes an Intern Stand Out (Bonus Skills)

If a student wants to comfortably clear interviews at tech hubs like Infopark or Bangalore, having any of these gives an immediate edge over freshers:

* **Basic Cloud/Deployment:** Knowing how to deploy an app to a live server (VPS like Ubuntu/DigitalOcean, Render, or AWS EC2\).
* **Docker Basics:** Understanding how to containerize a Django app.
* **AI/ML Integration:** Since many Python backends power AI tools, basic exposure to integrating OpenAI/LLM APIs into a Django backend is highly valued right now.

Pay: From ₹10,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
How you can make an impact
   

  

 In our People \& Organization (P\&O) team, you help create a great employee experience by supporting key HR and recruitment processes that keep our organization running smoothly and compliantly.
   

  

* You actively support talent sourcing activities, using various channels to help build a diverse, high‑quality candidate pool.

* You facilitate job postings in Workday and ensure they are up to date, accurate and aligned with our requirements.
* You conduct initial phone screens to assess candidates’ qualifications and fit, providing a professional first impression of Eppendorf.
* You coordinate interviews and meetings, managing calendars and scheduling to ensure a smooth and structured recruitment workflow.
* You maintain clear, timely communication with candidates, answering questions and keeping them informed about their status in the process.
* You update recruitment reports on a regular basis, providing visibility into the progress and status of open positions.
* You support background verification processes, helping to ensure a reliable and compliant assessment of candidate credentials.
* You contribute to continuous improvement in the recruitment life cycle by sharing observations and ideas for more efficient processes.
* You support the coordination of Mercer tests and other assessments, helping ensure a consistent and fair evaluation of candidates.
* You assist in various HR operations activities as needed (e.g. onboarding support, documentation, employee queries), gaining broad exposure to the P\&O function.
* You contribute to the payroll process, supporting accuracy, timeliness and compliance with internal policies and local regulations.
* You help compile statutory reports for India and MEA, ensuring adherence to legal and regulatory requirements.
* You collaborate on creating quick guides and simple explanations for APA policies, making complex information accessible and easy to understand for employees and managers.


 What sets you apart
   

  

* Bringing a bachelor’s degree / master's degree in human resources, business administration, psychology, commerce or a related field – or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience (e.g. internships).
* Showing strong interest in HR, talent acquisition and people topics, and a desire to build a career in the P\&O field.
* Ideally bringing initial experience (e.g. internship, apprenticeship or project work) in recruitment, HR operations or administrative roles.
* Working confidently with Microsoft Office, especially Excel and Word, and being eager to learn new digital tools and HR systems (experience with Workday is an advantage).
* Communicating clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing, and representing Eppendorf in a service‑oriented and friendly manner towards candidates and colleagues.
* Being well‑organized, reliable and detail‑oriented, able to handle multiple tasks, follow defined processes and meet deadlines.
* Demonstrating a proactive, hands‑on mindset: you ask questions, seek feedback and are curious to understand the “why” behind processes.
* Handling confidential information with discretion and acting with integrity in all HR‑related topics.
* Enjoying collaboration in a diverse, cross‑functional environment and being open to learning from experienced colleagues.


 What we offer
   

  

**Purpose and impact.** 
 At Eppendorf, you contribute to solutions that help improve people’s lives around the world – and you start your HR career in a meaningful environment.
   

  

**A learning‑focused role.** 
 As an apprentice, you receive close guidance from experienced P\&O colleagues and exposure to end‑to‑end HR and recruitment processes.
   

  

**Room to grow.** 
 You take on responsibility step by step, can bring in your ideas and see how your contribution supports candidates, employees and the business.
   

  

**Fair and supportive environment.** 
 We offer a culture based on collaboration, respect and openness, where questions are welcome and learning from mistakes is part of development.
   

  

**Development opportunities.** 
 With access to learning resources such as the Eppendorf Academy, digital platforms and workshops, you can continuously build your professional and personal skills.

description:
**About Taxplan**

 Taxplan is building an organized ecosystem for taxation and compliance services by combining professional expertise, technology, consultant network and customer\-focused service delivery.
   






**Role Summary** 





 We are looking for a dynamic, responsible and target\-oriented Business Development \& Revenue Manager who will be responsible for driving business growth and revenue for Taxplan.
 





 The candidate will be responsible for corporate tie\-ups, partnerships, client acquisition, lead conversion, revenue generation and managing Taxplan's Business Development interns.
 





 This is not only a sales role. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of revenue, build a structured business development process, manage interns, track performance and convert market opportunities into actual business.
 




**Compensation:** 

 Approx. ₹6 LPA. Performance\-based incentives may be considered based on revenue achievement.
 




  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Business Development \& Revenue Growth** 



* Generate new business opportunities for Taxplan through direct outreach, networking and referral channels.
* Identify and approach potential clients across segments — individuals, SMEs, business owners, housing societies, associations, educational institutions and startup communities — for Taxplan's taxation, GST, accounting and compliance services.
* Convert leads into paying clients and ensure monthly revenue targets are achieved.
* Create and maintain a strong pipeline of potential clients, partners and referral sources.
* Prepare and present Taxplan's business proposals to prospective clients and partners.
* Regularly follow up with leads and ensure timely closures.



**2\. Corporate Tie\-Ups \& Strategic Partnerships** 



* Build formal, ongoing tie\-ups with companies for employee tax filing programs, GST/accounting support, compliance services and advisory retainers.
* Develop relationships with HR teams, finance departments, business associations, startup networks and professional networks to establish Taxplan as their preferred compliance partner.
* Explore partnership opportunities with consultants, CA firms, educational institutions, banks and fintech companies for referral or co\-service arrangements.
* Negotiate and finalize commercial terms, proposals and collaboration models with management for corporate and institutional partnerships.


- 


**3\. BD Intern Team Handling** 



* Manage, guide and monitor Taxplan's Business Development interns.
* Assign daily and weekly business development targets to interns.
* Train interns on Taxplan's services, sales pitch, client handling and lead generation process.
* Track intern attendance, discipline, productivity and reporting.
* Review lead sheets, follow\-up status and conversion progress.
* Motivate interns and ensure their outreach activities result in measurable leads and revenue.
* Conduct regular review meetings with interns and report progress to management.



**4\. Sales Planning \& Execution** 



* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly business development plans.
* Set clear targets for self and interns.
* Track leads, meetings, follow\-ups, conversions and revenue.
* Maintain proper CRM / Excel / Google Sheet records of prospects, clients and partnerships.
* Coordinate with internal teams for smooth client onboarding and handover to the concerned Taxplan service team.
* Analyze sales performance and suggest improvements in strategy.
* Represent Taxplan professionally in corporate meetings, networking events, seminars and institutional discussions.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Strong business development and sales ability.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to handle corporate meetings and partnership discussions.
* Leadership ability to manage interns and junior team members.
* Strong follow\-up discipline and negotiation skills.
* Target\-oriented and revenue\-focused mindset.
* Ability to maintain reports, lead trackers and performance dashboards.
* Basic understanding of taxation, GST, accounting or compliance services will be preferred.
* Comfortable working in a startup environment with ownership and accountability.
* Knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets and CRM tools.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* 3 to 6 years of experience in Business Development, B2B Sales, Corporate Tie\-ups, Institutional Sales, Client Acquisition or Revenue Generation.
* Experience in fintech, taxation, CA firms, compliance services, financial services, banking, insurance, SaaS, edtech, HR services or professional services will be preferred.
* Prior experience in handling interns, field sales executives or junior sales teams will be an added advantage.



  





**Education** 





 Graduate / MBA / PG in Marketing, Sales, Business Management or related field.
 





 MBA is preferred but not compulsory if the candidate has strong practical sales and business development experience.
 




  





**Key Performance Indicators** 



* Monthly revenue generated.
* Number of corporate tie\-ups closed.
* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Number of paying clients converted.
* Number of meetings conducted.
* Intern productivity and lead conversion.
* Number of strategic partnerships developed.
* CRM / reporting accuracy.
* Follow\-up discipline.
* Contribution to Taxplan's overall growth.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 





 The ideal candidate should be a self\-driven business development professional who can work closely with the founders and take ownership of revenue.
 





 We are not looking for only a “sales talker.” We are looking for a person who can manage people, maintain reports, take regular follow\-ups, convert leads, guide interns and build a proper revenue system for Taxplan.
 





 The candidate should be mature, disciplined, target\-driven and capable of representing Taxplan professionally in the market.
 




  





**Reporting** 




**Reports To:** 

 Management / Founders of Taxplan Advisors Pvt. Ltd.
 




**Working / Reporting Office:** 

 Vasai West
 




  





**Role Description** 
 The Business Development \& Revenue Manager will be responsible for driving client acquisition, nurturing existing relationships, and identifying new growth opportunities for RMH Advisors. This full\-time, on\-site role based in Virar includes developing and executing revenue strategies, preparing proposals, and presenting service offerings to prospective and current clients. The role involves collaborating with internal teams to align service delivery with client needs, tracking performance against targets, and reporting progress to leadership. The manager will also analyze market trends, participate in networking activities, and support marketing initiatives to strengthen the firm’s presence and generate qualified leads.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong business development and sales skills, including lead generation, client relationship management, and negotiation capabilities.
* Candidates should possess financial and analytical skills, such as understanding accounting and tax concepts, interpreting financial data, and developing revenue forecasts.
* Candidates should possess communication and presentation skills, including clear written and verbal communication, proposal writing, and client\-facing presentation abilities.

* Candidates should possess organizational and collaboration skills, including time management, pipeline tracking, and effective coordination with internal teams.

* Comfort with using CRM tools, productivity software, and digital platforms to manage sales activities and reporting.

 1\.5degree is one of the fastest\-growing ice cream QSR brands, with its own in\-house manufacturing setup powering rapid outlet expansion. As we scale, we’re looking for an HR Manager who can build and run people processes that keep pace with a high\-growth, multi\-location, manufacturing\-plus\-retail environment.
 



 Role Overview
 



 We’re looking for an HR Manager with a proven track record in a similarly fast\-scaling F\&B/QSR or ice cream manufacturing setup, someone who has managed HR across both factory/plant and retail outlet teams, and who is comfortable using AI\-powered tools and HR software (Keka, Kasturi, or similar platforms) to run payroll, recruitment, and appraisals efficiently at scale.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Payroll \& Compliance: Manage end\-to\-end payroll processing for plant and outlet staff, ensure statutory compliance (PF, ESI, gratuity, labour laws), and maintain accurate attendance\-to\-payroll workflows.
 



 • Recruitment: Drive hiring across manufacturing, retail/outlet, and corporate roles to support rapid store and plant expansion; build scalable, tech\-enabled hiring pipelines.
 



 • Performance Appraisals: Design and run structured appraisal cycles, KRA/KPI frameworks, and performance review processes using HRMS tools.
 



 • HR Systems \& AI Tools: Leverage HRMS platforms (Kasturi or equivalent — Keka, Zoho People, greytHR, etc.) and AI\-based tools to streamline attendance tracking, payroll accuracy, reporting, and HR analytics.
 



 • Policy \& Culture: Develop and implement HR policies suited to a factory \+ retail hybrid workforce; drive engagement and retention across blue\-collar and white\-collar teams.
 



 • Stakeholder Management: Partner closely with plant heads, outlet operations, and leadership to align HR practices with business growth targets.
 



 Requirements
 



 • Experience: \~5 years of HR generalist experience, with meaningful exposure to a fast\-growing QSR/F\&B startup with its own manufacturing unit (ice cream or similar perishable/FMCG manufacturing preferred).
 



 • Software Proficiency: Hands\-on experience with HRMS/payroll software such as Kasturi, Keka, greytHR, Zoho People, or similar, along with comfort using AI\-based HR tools for recruitment screening, payroll processing, and performance tracking.
 



 • Core Skills: Strong grasp of payroll processing, statutory compliance, recruitment lifecycle management, and performance appraisal frameworks.
 



 • Education: MBA/PGDM in Human Resources (or equivalent relevant degree); additional certifications in HR analytics or HRMS tools are a plus.
 



 • Other: Ability to manage HR for a dual workforce — plant/manufacturing staff and retail/outlet teams — with strong stakeholder management and multitasking ability.
 



 Preferred
 



 • Prior experience in an ice cream, dairy, bakery, or similar perishable\-goods manufacturing environment.
 



 • Experience scaling HR processes during periods of rapid outlet/unit expansion.**

description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, we’re working to be the "Earth's Best Employer and Earth's Safest Place to Work." To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright and driven people. If you would like to help us make history, here’s your chance to accelerate our growth and ability to serve our employees and associates by joining the India Operations Employee Relations (ER) Team.
   

  

 The India Operations ER team supports Field Operations organizations across fulfilment and logistics business lines. The central objective of our team is to ensure treatment of employees and associates that is fair, respectful, and consistent with our framework of our core business values and objectives. To support that objective, ER team’s responsibilities fall into proactive and reactive categories.
   

  

 INOPS ER team is part of the Global Employee Relations vertical within Amazon, and works closely with the Field People eXperience and Technology (PXT / HR) teams and Operations teams in advising and enabling them to provide a seamless employee and associate experience.
   

  

 As an Employee Relations Manager (ERM), you will drive positive employee relations and enable positive associate and employee experience in your region and line of business.
   

  

 We are looking for candidates with who possess communication and interpersonal skills that let them communicate with ease, across levels from shop floor employees to senior leaders. The role will set in motion and numerous programs that develop and nurture a positive work environment, and advancing our work towards being the earth’s best employer. This position requires an individual who has employee relations experience. Experience and exposure to Indian statutory labor compliance laws will be helpful. Successful candidate will be able to independently own and drive broad spectrum of employee relations programs and handle issues. This role requires considerable domestic travel.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The individual will be responsible for the following types of proactive work:
   

  

* Problem Solve: Work independently with minimal supervision, in ambiguous situations, and persevere over internal and external barriers to drive resolutions. Analyze, diagnose, design, and revise people programs, policies, and practices to sustain positive employee relations
* Communicate Effectively: Rapidly produce high\-quality written communications that concisely analyze problems and recommends solutions; design and deliver highly\-engaging training sessions. Partner to engage in continuous improvement in communication vehicles and practices
* Analyze and Interpret Data: Exercise analytical skills using data and anecdotes to develop persuasive narratives and recommendations; demonstrated ability to define and measure success of programs. Design, collect, and analyze multiple levels of employee feedback
* Detect and Mitigate Risks: Apply employee and labor relations expertise to successfully identify trends, gaps, and challenges; execute solution\-focused strategies and programs to mitigate risks
* Project Management: Independently own large\-scale, network\-wide projects delivered on time that improve associate experience at a site and network level. Conduct and oversee employee relations vulnerability assessment programs


 The individual also will work reactively on critical employee relations issues that are crisis oriented and typically can only be successfully completed with limited time while exercising judgment. Time management between proactive and reactive responsibilities is a critical component for success in the position.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Program Management, Human Resources, Employment Law, Computer Science, Finance, Computer Information Systems, Engineering, Operations Research or a related field


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of HR, talent acquisition, management consulting, or project/program management experience

title: Senior HR Manager (India Tech Center)
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Team**
 Our India Technology Center (ITC) is a rapidly growing organization supporting global technology and digital initiatives across Williams\-Sonoma. With a strong base of engineering and product talent, ITC plays a critical role in delivering innovation, scalability, and business impact across our global platforms.
   

  

 The HR team partners closely with Technology leadership and associates to attract, develop, and retain exceptional talent. We are focused on building high\-performing teams, delivering data\-driven people solutions, and fostering an inclusive, high\-performance culture aligned with global priorities.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Senior HR Manager is a strategic, hands\-on partner who will play a key role in shaping the people agenda for the India Technology Center (ITC). In this role, you will work closely with senior Technology leaders (Director/VP level), helping translate business priorities into meaningful people strategies that enable teams to do their best work.
   

  

 You’ll be at the heart of building a high\-performing, inclusive, and scalable organization—driving initiatives across HR Business Partnership, Talent Development, and HR Operations. From strengthening leadership capability to enhancing employee experience, your work will directly impact how our teams grow and succeed.
   

  

 While you will partner closely with Talent Acquisition leadership to ensure hiring strategies are aligned with business needs and support ITC’s continued growth, the scope of this role may evolve over time to include broader responsibilities in this area.
   

  

 You’ll also partner with U.S. and global HR teams, gaining exposure to a truly international environment and helping bring together global best practices with local insights.
   

  

**Responsibilities** 
**Business Partnership**
* Partner with Technology leaders to align workforce strategy with business goals, including org design and workforce planning
* Provide coaching to managers on leadership capability, performance management, and team effectiveness
* Use HR analytics to identify trends (attrition, engagement, performance) and recommend actionable interventions
* Support and lead change management initiatives with structured execution and communication


**Performance, Development \& Engagement**
* Drive performance management processes including goal setting, reviews, and development planning
* Partner with leaders on talent reviews, succession planning, and capability building
* Design and implement engagement initiatives based on survey insights
* Build manager capability through structured training and coaching programs


**Compensation \& Benefits**
* Partner with Global Total Rewards team on compensation benchmarking and reward strategies
* Provide insights on market competitiveness and retention strategies
* Ensure effective communication and understanding of benefits programs among associates


**Associate Relations**
* Provide guidance on associate relations matters including performance concerns, investigations, and exits
* Ensure fair, consistent, and legally compliant resolution aligned with company values
* Proactively identify and mitigate employee relations risks


**HR Operations \& Compliance**
* Ensure compliance with Indian labor laws and statutory requirements (e.g., Shops \& Establishment Act, POSH, PF, Gratuity)
* Maintain HRIS (Oracle) data integrity and leverage analytics for workforce insights
* Partner with Legal, Payroll, and Global HR teams for operational excellence and audit readiness
* Adapt global policies to align with local legal and cultural requirements


**People Leadership**
* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing HR team
* Set clear priorities aligned with business needs and drive accountability for outcomes
* Build HR capability to support organizational scale and maturity
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high\-performance team culture grounded in trust and continuous improvement


**Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding**
* Partner closely with Talent Acquisition and ITC leadership to support hiring strategies aligned with business growth and workforce plans
* Provide input into workforce planning, role prioritization, and hiring needs based on evolving business objectives
* Collaborate to ensure strong alignment on candidate profiles, hiring quality, and overall candidate experience
* Contribute to building effective onboarding experiences that enable strong integration and early productivity of new hires
* Support continuous improvement of hiring and onboarding practices, with the potential to take on broader responsibilities in this area over time
* Oversee associate’s onboarding programs to ensure effective integration and early productivity of new hires


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in human resources or related field or equivalent work experience
* 8–10 years of progressive HR experience, including HRBP and talent development experience
* Experience in global or matrixed organizations, preferably in product companies or Global Capability Centers (GCCs)
* Proven experience supporting Technology/Engineering organizations in high\-growth environments
* Experience partnering with Talent Acquisition teams or exposure to hiring strategies in high\-growth environments
* Strong understanding of the Indian talent market, especially in major tech hubs
* Deep knowledge of Indian labor laws and compliance requirements
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and manage complex stakeholder environments
* Experience scaling organizations and managing high\-volume hiring
* Strong analytical mindset with experience using HR data to drive decisions
* High ownership and ability to operate in ambiguous, fast\-paced environments
* Strong problem\-solving skills with a drive for results
* Learning agility and adaptability to evolving business needs
* High integrity and commitment to fostering a respectful, inclusive workplace
* This role requires being onsite in the Pune, India office 3 \- 4 days per week


**Why Join Williams\-Sonoma India Technology Center**
* Our people first and performance driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career and invest in the well\-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family.
* Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high\-ownership that empowers engineers to make real impact.
* Build and operate large\-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale.
* Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting\-edge technologies, AI\-driven solutions, and large\-scale engineering challenges.
* Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with in\-office days for team engagement.


**About Us**
 Founded in 1956, Williams\-Sonoma Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high\-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Today, Williams\-Sonoma, Inc. is one of the United States' largest e\-commerce retailers with some of the best known and most beloved brands in home furnishings. Our family of brands are Williams\-Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Williams\-Sonoma Home, Rejuvenation, GreenRow and Mark and Graham. We currently operate retail stores globally. Our products are also available to customers through our catalogs and online worldwide.
   

  

 Williams\-Sonoma has established a technology center in Pune, India to enhance its global operations. The India Technology Center serves as a critical hub for innovation and focuses on developing cutting\-edge solutions in areas such as e\-commerce, supply chain optimization, and customer experience management. By integrating advanced technologies like artificial intelligence, data analytics, and machine learning, the India Technology Center plays a crucial role in accelerating Williams\-Sonoma's growth and maintaining its competitive edge in the global market

description:
**Milacron**
