title: Product Designer
description:
**Role:** 

 Product Designer — Mobile WFO Bangalore \| 3–5 years \| AI\-native IT Services
 




**Apply Link** 

 \-
 
 https://theproducthighway.keka.com/careers/jobdetails/138
 



  





**About TPH** 





 The Product Highway is an AI\-native product strategy and engineering firm that partners with businesses from the earliest spark of an idea all the way through to enterprise scale. We grew from zero to multi\-million ARR within our first year, working with clients across India, APAC, Europe, and North America.
 






 ﻿
 






 AI got very good at the "how", shipping code faster than ever. But almost nothing has changed in the what: deciding what to build, why, and in what order. That's where we live. We believe software is an approximation of the real world, and what matters isn't lines of code or sprint velocity, it's whether the solution actually maps to how a business works, how customers think, and how value gets created.
 





 From in\-house AI project managers to near\-universal adoption of tools like Cursor and Claude, we've rethought every conventional process from first principles. AI isn't a feature we offer, it's how we think, build, and deliver.
 




  





**Why we're hiring** 





 Our engagements are getting more design\-intensive. We're building consumer products where the quality of the interface is the product. Apps where interaction patterns, motion, and visual craft are the difference between something people tolerate and something people love. That requires a designer who can carry the full weight of the visual and interaction layer across a mobile product.
 




  






 The PM and Product Engineer own the what. They define problems, set priorities, and make product decisions. Your job is to make those decisions tangible. You take a problem statement and a set of requirements and turn them into screens, flows, interactions, and systems that feel inevitable when someone uses them. You own how the product looks, moves, and feels.
 




  






 This is a craft role. We're hiring you because you're exceptionally good at designing mobile interfaces. You have an opinion about spacing, about how a transition should feel, about whether a bottom sheet or a modal is the right pattern for a given context. You notice when something is 2px off. You care about the details that most people can't articulate but everyone can feel.
 




  






 You'll work across client engagements, primarily on mobile products (Android and iOS). You collaborate closely with the PM who sets the product direction and with engineers who build what you design. The quality of what ships is directly shaped by the quality of what you hand off.
 




  





**Who we're looking for** 





 Regardless of role, every person at TPH shares these traits:
 



* End\-to\-end owners. You own outcomes, not tasks. If something you're responsible for falls through a crack, that's on you, because bugs are easier to fix, misalignment is expensive.
* Clear, direct communicators. Bad news doesn't get better with age. You surface problems early and communicate with precision.
* Uncompromising on quality. You have a quality bar that's yours, not your manager's. You won't ship something you wouldn't stand behind, even under deadline pressure.
* AI\-obsessed. You see AI as how work gets done, not a nice\-to\-have. If you're still doing something manually that AI could handle, you feel that as friction, not normalcy.
* Structured thinkers. When faced with an ambiguous problem, you break it down, reason through the trade\-offs, and arrive at a position. You don't wait for someone to tell you the answer.



  





**What you'll own** 




*Visual Design \& Interaction* 



* Own the visual layer of the products you work on. Every screen, every state, every transition. You're the reason the product feels polished, not just functional.
* Design high\-fidelity screens for mobile apps, websites and dashboards.
* Own interaction design and motion. You think about how elements enter and exit, how feedback feels, how a swipe or a long\-press should respond. Microinteractions aren't an afterthought for you.



*Design Systems \& Component Libraries* 



* Build and maintain design systems that scale. Typography, color, spacing, component libraries, interaction patterns. You create the foundation that keeps a product visually coherent as it grows.
* Ensure components are designed with engineering handoff in mind. Your Figma files are organized, your specs are clear, your naming conventions make sense to developers.
* Own cross\-platform consistency. You know how to design a system that feels native on both Android and iOS without maintaining two entirely separate design languages.



*Collaboration \& Handoff* 



* Work with the PM to understand the problem and constraints before you start designing. You don't need to define the problem yourself, but you need to fully understand it so your design actually solves it.
* Collaborate with engineers throughout the build, not just at handoff. You're available for questions, you review implementations, and you flag when something doesn't match the design.
* Present your work and explain your decisions. When the PM or the client asks "why this pattern?", you have a clear answer rooted in the user's context, the platform's constraints, or the interaction model you've chosen.
* Incorporate feedback quickly. You don't treat design as precious. You iterate fast, test assumptions visually, and move toward the right answer through exploration.



*User Experience* 



* While the PM owns the product logic, you own the experience of using it. You think about flows end\-to\-end: onboarding, empty states, error states, edge cases. You don't just design the happy path.
* Bring a strong instinct for how real people use mobile apps. You know where thumbs rest, how scroll fatigue works, what makes a bottom navigation feel intuitive, and when a gesture is clever versus confusing.
* Advocate for the user's experience in design reviews and sprint discussions. If something feels off, you say so and you show why.



  





**Must\-haves** 



* 2–5 years designing websites, dashboards, and mobile apps that shipped to real users. You have a portfolio of work you can walk us through.
* Exceptional visual craft. Your screens look polished. Your spacing is intentional. Your typography choices are deliberate. This is immediately visible in your portfolio.
* Strong interaction and motion design instincts. You think about transitions, gestures, and feedback as core parts of the design, not finishing touches.
* Fluent in Figma. Auto\-layout, components, variants, prototyping. Your files are clean enough that another designer or an engineer can pick them up without a walkthrough.
* You've built or contributed to a design system. You understand tokens, component architecture, and how to design for reuse without sacrificing flexibility.
* You understand platform conventions for Android (Material) and iOS (HIG) well enough to make informed decisions about when to follow them and when to diverge.
* You work fast without sacrificing quality. In a services environment, you'll often need to move from problem to high\-fidelity screens within a sprint. That pace needs to feel natural, not stressful.
* You can take direction from a PM or Product Engineer on what to solve and independently own how it looks and feels. You don't need someone to art\-direct you.



  





**AI\-native expectations** 



* Uses AI tools daily in your design workflow. Generating visual explorations, creating placeholder content, iterating on copy, mocking up variations quickly.
* Comfortable evaluating AI\-generated design assets and knowing when they're production\-ready versus when they need refinement.
* Thinks about how AI changes the design process. You use it to move faster through exploration so you can spend more time on the decisions that matter.



  





**Not the right fit if** 



* Your portfolio is primarily web dashboards and enterprise SaaS.
* You think of yourself as a "UX designer" who hands off wireframes and expects someone else to make them look good. At TPH, the designer who defines the interaction is the same person who polishes the pixels.
* You need a week to go from requirements to a first design. Our pace requires you to produce high\-quality work quickly, and you should find that energizing.
* You're uncomfortable working without detailed creative briefs. The PM will give you the problem and the constraints. The visual and interaction direction is yours to own.
* You don't have strong opinions about how things should look and feel. We need a designer who pushes the work forward with a point of view, not one who waits for feedback to know if something is good.



  





**How to apply** 





 Share your portfolio. Walk us through one product you designed where the visual craft made a measurable difference to the user experience. Tell us what you'd do differently if you designed it today. We care about your eye, your taste, and how you think about the details.

**About The Team**

title: Technical Documentation Engineer
description:

As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.
   

  

 Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy\-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.
   

  

 Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9\.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2\.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.
   

  

 With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.
   

  

**Documentation Engineer — Harness**
**About The Role**
 Harness is building a modern documentation organization to support a rapidly evolving product portfolio and global customer base. We are looking for a
 **Documentation Engineer** 
 who can create clear, accurate, and customer\-focused documentation while growing into a strong owner within a structured, engineering\-driven environment.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone with a solid foundation in technical documentation who is ready to take on broader ownership, deepen their product understanding, and increase their impact on the customer experience through documentation.
   

  

 You will work closely with Senior Documentation Engineers, Product Managers, Engineers, and Support teams to ensure documentation helps customers understand not just
 *how* 
 features work, but also
 *why* 
 they exist and how they fit into real\-world use cases.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Own documentation for defined features and areas**
* Create and maintain documentation for product features, workflows, and configurations within assigned areas.
* Manage documentation updates through drafting, review cycles, revisions, and publication with guidance for more complex topics.
* Ensure documentation is accurate, up to date, and aligned with product behavior and UI changes.


**Contribute to clear, usable, customer\-focused content**
* Write documentation that goes beyond step\-by\-step instructions by explaining key concepts, use cases, and the reasoning behind important design or configuration choices.
* Improve content clarity by organizing information logically, defining prerequisites, and anticipating common user questions.
* Help identify gaps, outdated sections, and confusing areas in existing documentation and propose improvements.


**Work effectively in an engineering\-driven environment**
* Collaborate with Engineering and Product teams to understand feature behavior, limitations, and intended use cases.
* Ask clarifying questions to ensure technical accuracy and to better understand the user impact of new features.
* Work with documentation tools and workflows to manage updates, track work, and participate in review processes.


**Support team execution and delivery**
* Complete documentation tasks aligned with product releases and team priorities.
* Track work through systems such as JIRA and participate in planning and review discussions.
* Raise blockers early and seek guidance when requirements or inputs are unclear.


**Core Qualifications**
**What we are looking for**
* 2 to 4 years of experience in technical documentation, developer documentation, or product documentation.
* Ability to understand and document product workflows, configurations, and user\-facing features.
* Strong written communication skills with attention to clarity, structure, and accuracy.
* Ability to explain both how something works and why it matters to the user.
* Comfortable collaborating with engineers and product managers to gather information and clarify technical details.
* Familiarity with using task tracking tools such as JIRA to manage documentation work.
* Basic understanding of Git, version control concepts, and Markdown, with the ability to work in structured documentation environments.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in SaaS, cloud, DevOps, developer tools, or security products.
* Exposure to docs\-as\-code workflows (such as Git\-based collaboration and pull request reviews).
* Experience improving existing documentation for clarity, completeness, or usability based on feedback.


**How You Work**
**Customer\-focused**
 You think about who is reading the documentation and what they are trying to achieve. You write with the user’s goals, confusion points, and decision moments in mind.
   

  

**Collaborative and communicative**
 You work well with engineers, product managers, and peers, asking thoughtful questions and sharing progress regularly.
   

  

**Growth\-oriented**
 You are open to feedback, eager to improve your craft, and interested in learning more about both the product and documentation best practices over time.
   

  

**Harness In The News**
* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5\.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale \| Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success


 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.
   

  

 At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness\-privacy.relyance.ai/
   

  

**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**
 We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.
   

  

 Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job\-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

 You'll work within established frameworks to deliver tactical analytics solutions using SQL and Amazon Quick.  Build and maintain SQL queries and Amazon Quick dashboards to support business needs

 Perform analyses to identify opportunities in registration and verification processes

title: Senior Information Developer
description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.
   

  

 A senior CAD professional with deep, hands\-on design experience who is ready to expand their career into information development, using that expertise to create documentation and other user assistance that helps customers harness the power of Designcenter NX.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has spent years in industry creating structures such as complex assemblies, wire routings, harness designs, piping layouts, cable tray layouts, and ship designs. They know the complexity, the edge cases, and the workflows that matter, and are now motivated to put that knowledge to work creating authoritative, practitioner\-grade content that advanced design engineers can rely on.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Learns the software product, conducts research, and becomes a subject\-matter expert.
* Develops user\-focused content, including online help, tutorials, graphics, and videos.
* Plans, develops, and maintains new and existing information solutions for end users of CAD software.
* Uses Madcap IXIA (DITA XML) content\-authoring tool to compose end\-user user documentation.
* Communicates project progress to collaborators through meetings and status updates.
* Works closely with other internal teams to develop and track deliverables.


**Skills and Abilities Required:**
* Expertise and practical design experience with CAD software, especially wire routing, harness design, piping layout, cable tray layout, ship design, and working with large assemblies.
* Ability to understand technical/mechanical engineering concepts and to learn complex, specialized CAD product functionality and applications.
* Demonstrated user\-focused technical writing ability. Must be able to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and effectively.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently in a dynamic environment.
* Ability to work on multiple complex projects simultaneously.
* Strong interpersonal communication skills. Effectively communicates in one\-to\-one and group situations.


**Education and Experience Requirement:**
* Bachelor’s degree (or international graduate of an equivalent university\-level program) in mechanical engineering, technical communication, or related field.
* 8 years of relevant industry experience.
* Previous experience with Siemens NX CAD and Siemens Teamcenter software is desired.
* Ability to use generative AI to improve productivity.


**Why us?**
 Working at Siemens Software means flexibility \- Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.
   

  

 A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we Work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
   

  

 Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

title: Content Writer
description:
**About Us** 




 Volopay is a Y Combinator\-backed start\-up that combines corporate cards, bills payments, approvals, expense reimbursements, and accounting automation in one single platform. We empower businesses to manage, grow and succeed with our cross\-platform solution that delivers more functionality across different areas of operations. We are backed by some of the top investors in the world, and on our way to being one of the most influential fintech start\-ups in Southeast Asia, with ambitions to expand. For selling a platform like this, we need people who are super excited about the vision of the company and who are passionately curious about building this for businesses out there.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We’re looking for content writers to write content and copy for our global website (English) as well as for our blogs (English). Writers will be expected to write clear, comprehensive and user friendly content that complies with our brand language, SEO requirements, and product specifications. The role will also include the expectation to coherently communicate our primary marketing message through the written word, as well as to edit your own work for maximum readability.
 



 If you already have experience in writing online, then please feel free to attach a portfolio of work when submitting your assignment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Write blogs, landing pages, website copy, and product\-related content for the global website while ensuring alignment with brand guidelines and marketing objectives.
* Research industry trends, competitor content, and fintech\-related topics to create relevant content pieces and PR articles.
* Proofread and edit content for grammar, readability, clarity, and consistency while maintaining high\-quality standards.
* Collaborate with the marketing team to develop campaigns, messaging, and SEO\-optimized content based on keyword strategies and recommendations.
* Simplify complex financial and payment\-related concepts into engaging and easy\-to\-understand content while maintaining consistency in brand tone across all channels.
* Support product launches, campaigns, and customer education initiatives while meeting content deadlines effectively.



  





**Skills \& Qualifications** 



* Strong written and spoken English communication skills with the ability to create high\-quality website content.
* Basic understanding of SEO\-compliant writing and content optimization strategies.
* Ability to collaborate effectively within a remote team environment while adhering to deadlines and participating in productive discussions.
* Flexibility in writing style to align with existing brand language guidelines and the ability to independently edit and proofread content for grammar, readability, and conciseness.
* Strong research skills with the ability to stay updated on industry\-related topics and trends to enhance content quality.
* Minimum 2–3\+ years of experience in creating website content, including personal blogs or non\-academic writing experience.
* Knowledge of Google Docs and familiarity with using AI tools to improve content operations.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced startup environment.



  





**Our Culture** 




 At Volopay, you'll thrive among passionate, talented individuals who bring their energy into everything they do. Our team's diversity is our strength, with musicians, entrepreneurs, athletes, and more contributing their unique talents. Picture a workplace that's not just about work, but about a shared journey. We value your independence and trust you with tasks, encouraging you to take ownership and find innovative solutions. Our culture is rooted in:
 


* **Ownership:** 
 We believe in freedom with responsibility. You'll naturally take the lead and excel.
* **Results:** 
 We're doers who overcome obstacles with a can\-do attitude.
* **Curiosity:** 
 Curious minds thrive here. Wear multiple hats and embrace new challenges.



  





*Join Volopay for a vibrant, dynamic atmosphere where innovation thrives, and your individuality shines.*

description:

 Cuemath is the world’s highest\-rated math learning platform, trusted by 10,000\+ families across the US. We make students MathFit™ through personalized 1:1 live learning focused on deep understanding, problem\-solving, and real\-world application.
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for a growth\-oriented Content Writer to join our website team and help us
 



 capture the attention of parents and students worldwide. In an era of generic, AI\-generated filler,
 



 we are looking for a writer who champions first\-hand research, absolute factual accuracy, and
 



 human\-centric storytelling.
 



 Your goal is to write high\-quality blogs that drive organic growth and capture users across every
 



 modern discovery funnel, whether they are searching on Google, asking an AI engine, or
 



 discovering us through community recommendations.

 ● Original, Deep\-Dive Writing: Write high\-quality blogs that cut through the noise. Conduct firsthand research to ensure everything is factually accurate and free of generic AI patterns.

 ● SEO Principles: Apply modern on\-page SEO best practices, focusing on user intent, authority, and trust to build sustainable organic traffic.
 



 ● Content Freshness: Regularly audit and update existing website content to maintain its relevance, authority, and high ranking in a fast\-evolving search landscape.
 



 ● Collaboration: Work with the website and marketing teams to ensure a consistent, authoritative brand voice across all international markets.

 ● Experience: At least 1\-2 years of experience in content writing, specifically within the Ed\-Tech sector or a similar field.
 



 ● Human\-First Approach: You have a distinct, engaging writing voice. While you may use AI for brainstorming, your final output relies on original thought and deep research.

 ● International Market Knowledge: Ability to write in native\-level US English that appeals to a worldwide audience.

description:
**Meet the Team**
 Our Incident Command Software Engineering team is a diverse and hardworking group that shares a passion for sophisticated software and computer security. We stay a step ahead of the evolving threat landscape in an AI\-enabled, fast\-paced Agile environment, combining Kanban, continuous integration and deployment, and close collaboration with vendors, partners, and industry leaders.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a Software Engineer, you will help build and extend next\-generation incident detection and response services for Cisco. You will work closely with internal security investigation and analysis teams to design workflows, systems, and processes that deliver reliable, scalable, and effective security services.
   

  

* Apply AI tools in software engineering code development, testing, and delivered solutions to meet business goals.
* Develop software consistent with Cisco Design Thinking Principles, with a focus on simplification, user experience, secure coding practices, user privacy, and software development best practices.
* Collaborate on small\-to\-medium features from technical design through completion, including requirements analysis, design, coding, unit testing, and acceptance testing.
* Prototype automation and tooling that improves detection, prevention, reliability, and security operations capabilities.
* Maintain production application environments, debug software issues, resolve reliability and availability problems efficiently, and participate in on\-call support as needed.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* One to three years of experience in a software engineering role.
* Experience writing software in one or more languages such as Python, Go, Java, or a similar language in a Linux or Unix\-based environment, and experience in one or more databases, such as MySQL
* Experience with CI/CD, including building and deploying containers using orchestration platforms such as Docker Swarm or Kubernetes.
* Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and secure, performant, fault\-tolerant systems.
* Experience developing software with AI coding generators and reviewing AI\-generated code to identify issues and demonstrate understanding of the codebase.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience applying AI technologies to solutions that meet stakeholder needs.
* Full stack development experience.
* Ability to design solutions that efficiently use, move, transform, and supply large amounts of data supporting security operations.
* Experience collaborating with domain experts across security, engineering, vendor, partner, and industry teams.
* Interest in learning internet security from and with a team of experts.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

 Background

 Fully functional website built on a supported CMS.
 



 Compliance with WCAG 2\.2 (or higher), EN 301 549, and applicable government standards.
 



 Improved navigation and access to services.
 



 Optimized performance, SEO, and usability.

 Adhere to government security, accessibility, privacy, and web development standards.

 Developing and maintaining CMS\-based websites (Drupal, WordPress, etc.).

 PHP, JavaScript, SQL, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and TWIG.

 Git and modern software development practices.

 CMS content editing components and accessible digital experiences.

 Content and functionality recommendations.

 Wireframes and visual designs for key page templates.
 



 Up to two rounds of design revisions.

 Website Development
 



 Responsive, mobile\-first website.

 CMS installation and configuration.
 



 Cross\-browser and device compatibility.

 Integration of client\-provided content.
 



 Light content formatting and optimization.
 



 Support for client\-provided licensed imagery.
 



 Integrations \& Functionality
 



 Up to two simple contact or inquiry forms.

 SEO fundamentals including metadata, indexing, and performance optimization.

title: Android Developer
description: The technology stack for the QR Mobile App (Android) features a Kotlin\-first codebase using modern, concise, and safer code, with a UI built on Jetpack Compose for a declarative, reactive, and future\-proof experience. The core technologies include Kotlin and Java, while the UI and frontend utilize Jetpack Compose, Material Design 3, Lottie Animations, Coil, and Media3/ExoPlayer for video playback and HLS streaming. Networking and API interactions are handled by Retrofit, OkHttp, and KotlinX Serialization, with data and storage managed through Room for local SQLite databases with coroutines support and SharedPreferences for lightweight key\-value storage. Asynchronous programming is powered by Kotlin Coroutines for non\-blocking async operations without callbacks, alongside StateFlow, SharedFlow, and legacy LiveData for reactive state management. Dependency injection is achieved via Hilt and KSP, while navigation is managed through Jetpack Navigation, offering type\-safe navigation with Safe Args to prevent runtime errors and support for deep linking. Firebase provides analytics, crash reporting via Crashlytics, push notifications through FCM, remote config, and performance monitoring, complemented by the Adobe Experience Cloud for enterprise analytics and session replay via Quantum Metric. Security and authentication are prioritized with Biometric Authentication, OAuth 2\.0, DexGuard for code obfuscation, OneTrust CMP, and fraud detection using Akamai BMP and InMobile. The architecture employs the MVI pattern, Repository pattern, modular architecture, and Clean Architecture to ensure a modular, testable, and maintainable system with separated concerns across UI, Domain, and Data layers. Testing and quality assurance include unit testing with JUnit 5, MockK, and Google Truth, integration testing with Espresso and Compose UI tests, flow testing using Turbine, and code quality maintenance through Detekt, SonarQube, and Lint, alongside code coverage reporting via Kover. Build and deployment processes utilize build flavors for Dev, UAT, and Prod across Google and Huawei ecosystems, supported by Gradle\-based CI/CD integration for enterprise analytics and multi\-regional support.

title: Benefits Operations Manager
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

Benefits is one of Rippling's largest and most critical product categories, and the Benefits Operations organization plays a pivotal role in delivering an exceptional customer experience at scale. The team manages tens of thousands of enrollments annually while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence.


Rippling is seeking a Benefits Operations Manager to lead a team of Operations Supervisors responsible for multiple operational functions within Benefits. This leader will drive organizational performance through frontline leaders, establish scalable operating mechanisms, identify opportunities for automation and process optimization, and partner cross\-functionally to solve complex operational challenges.


The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with analytical rigor, operational excellence, and the ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders to improve customer outcomes and business performance.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Operations Supervisors, building a high\-performing organization through effective manager development and succession planning.
* Own end\-to\-end operational performance across multiple teams, including productivity, quality, SLA attainment, customer experience, and capacity utilization.
* Establish operating rhythms and review mechanisms to monitor KPIs, identify trends, and drive accountability for results.
* Drive workforce planning activities including forecasting, capacity planning, hiring strategies, and organizational design to support business growth and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives with Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Support, and other internal stakeholders to address systemic issues, drive alignment, and improve the customer experience.
* Lead and prioritize automation opportunities, process redesign efforts, and tooling enhancements to improve efficiency and scalability.
* Present regular business reviews to senior leadership, highlighting performance outcomes, emerging risks, operational health, and strategic initiatives.
* Proactively identify potential operational challenges and implement preventive controls to mitigate business and customer impact.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 6\-8 years of experience in customer\-facing operations environments such as Insurance operations, benefits operations, business operations/ product operations, or support operations.
* Minimum 3–5 years of people management experience, including direct experience leading frontline managers/ supervisors/team leaders.
* Demonstrated success managing large\-scale operations with ownership of service delivery, performance metrics, and customer outcomes.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with experience translating data into strategic decisions and operational improvements.
* Experience with capacity planning, workforce management, organizational design, and resource allocation.
* Proven ability to influence and partner effectively with cross\-functional stakeholders across multiple levels of the organization.
* Excellent project management and execution skills with a track record of driving complex initiatives to completion.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership.
* Strong proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, particularly Sheets/Excel, for reporting and analysis; familiarity with SFDC, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments and effectively prioritize competing business needs.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset with a bias for action and continuous improvement.
* Prior experience in a SaaS or high\-growth startup environment preferred.
* Ability to work partly on U.S. hours (Eastern time zone \- EST); standard shift timings would be 1 PM \- 10 PM IST.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: Closing Manager - Real Estate
description:
**Closing Manager – Real Estate Sales**
=======================================


**Empowering Real Estate Success Through Strategy, Sales \& Execution**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------


**Position: Closing Manager**
-----------------------------


### **Role Overview**


As a Closing Manager, you will be responsible for converting qualified prospects into successful property bookings. You will represent premium real estate projects, interact with serious homebuyers and investors, conduct project presentations, and guide customers throughout the purchase journey.


This role is ideal for professionals who thrive in a target\-driven environment, enjoy building client relationships, and possess a strong ability to negotiate and close deals.


Your contribution will directly impact project success and revenue growth.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Sales \& Client Relationship Management**


* Engage with prospective buyers generated through walk\-ins, digital campaigns, channel partners, referrals, and inbound enquiries.
* Understand customer requirements, budgets, and investment objectives.
* Build trust and long\-term relationships with potential buyers.
* Maintain a professional and consultative sales approach throughout the customer journey.

### **Property Presentations \& Site Visits**


* Conduct project presentations and site visits for prospective clients.
* Explain project specifications, amenities, location advantages, floor plans, pricing structures, payment plans, and investment benefits.
* Effectively communicate the project's unique selling propositions (USPs).

### **Deal Closure \& Revenue Generation**


* Manage the complete sales cycle from enquiry generation to booking confirmation.
* Handle negotiations, objections, and customer concerns confidently.
* Create urgency and drive timely decision\-making.
* Achieve and exceed assigned monthly and quarterly sales targets.

### **Documentation \& Coordination**


* Coordinate with sourcing teams, channel partners, CRM teams, and back\-office departments to ensure smooth transaction processing.
* Assist customers with booking procedures, documentation, and payment schedules.
* Ensure compliance with all required documentation and company processes.

### **CRM Management \& Reporting**


* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and follow\-ups in CRM software.
* Track lead status and sales pipeline movement.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance reports.

### **Market Intelligence**


* Stay updated on Mumbai real estate trends, competitor projects, pricing movements, and customer preferences.
* Share market insights that can help improve sales strategies and customer engagement.

**Candidate Profile**
---------------------


### **Experience**


* Minimum 2 years of experience in real estate sales, BFSI, or automobile sales.
* Senior\-level opportunities available for experienced professionals with strong industry networks.
* Senior\-level opportunities available for candidates with extensive closing experience and strong sales achievements.
* Prior experience in real estate projects is preferred.

### **Skills Required**


* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Excellent negotiation and persuasion abilities.
* Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets.
* Strong objection\-handling and relationship\-building skills.
* Customer\-focused mindset with high professionalism.
* CRM proficiency and disciplined follow\-up management.

### **Educational Qualifications**


* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Real Estate, or related fields.
* MBA or equivalent qualification will be an added advantage.

JC Global is one of India's fastest\-growing Circular Economy companies engaged in manufacturing premium recycled polymer granules and Polymer Pyrolysis Oil (PPO). Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). * Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.

* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.

 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**ETAP empowers customers to make informed decisions throughout the life cycle of their projects with innovative software solutions for electrical systems. By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP supports customers in their digital transformation and sustainable energy transitions for a green and smart future, helping them to prioritize safety, maximize reliability, and stay resilient.**

**Our employees' passion for excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction is our most\-prized resource. If you share that passion — and want to be part of a company that leads the energy transition towards a cleaner and more resilient world for future generations — we invite you to join us!**

**ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

**Position:** Talent Acquisition Specialist
  

**Location:** Mumbai (Hybrid)
  

**Employment Type:** Full\-time, Regular


### **About the Role**

We are seeking a driven and experienced Talent Acquisition Specialist to lead end\-to\-end hiring for our technology product organization, supporting talent needs across **India and the MEA (Middle East \& Africa) region** . This role requires a proactive recruiter who can partner closely with hiring managers, understand complex technical requirements, and deliver high\-quality talent efficiently across multiple geographies.


The ideal candidate brings strong sourcing expertise, excellent stakeholder management skills, and a solid understanding of regional hiring dynamics. You will play a critical role in building diverse, high\-performing teams while ensuring an exceptional candidate experience.


### **Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with hiring managers across India and MEA to understand hiring needs and develop effective recruitment strategies
* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from requisition to offer closure across multiple geographies
* Source and attract top talent through multiple channels including job boards, LinkedIn, referrals, and industry networks
* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines across India and MEA markets
* Screen, interview, and evaluate candidates using structured and competency\-based assessment methods
* Provide informed recommendations and market insights to hiring managers
* Drive offer discussions, negotiate compensation, and ensure timely closures
* Ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience across all touchpoints
* Maintain accurate records in Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and candidate databases
* Stay updated on talent trends, compensation benchmarks, and hiring practices across India and MEA
* Continuously improve recruitment processes and drive operational excellence
* Promote fair, unbiased hiring practices aligned with Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Wellbeing commitments

### **Essential Skills \& Capabilities**

* Proven experience in Talent Acquisition or similar roles
* Strong expertise in sourcing and networking, particularly via LinkedIn and digital platforms
* Demonstrated experience hiring across a **diverse range of roles** , including Electrical Engineers, Software Engineers, Project Managers, Sales Engineers, and related functions
* Experience hiring across India and/or international regions (MEA exposure is a plus)
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Solid understanding of recruitment processes, hiring metrics, and labor laws
* Hands\-on experience with ATS platforms (e.g., Workday)
* Strong interviewing skills including behavioral and competency\-based techniques
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines
* High attention to detail and strong confidentiality standards
* Effective negotiation and influencing skills

### **Experience Required**

* 6\+ years of end\-to\-end Talent Acquisition experience within a technology product organization
* Proven experience in hiring/sourcing/recruiting for roles such as **Energy Management Software specialists, Software Engineers, Electrical Engineers, and Engineering Sales specialists**
* Experience hiring for technical and/or corporate roles in a global environment
* Experience supporting hiring across India and exposure to MEA markets preferred
* Prior experience working within a People/HR team, with understanding of HR policies and the employee lifecycle

### **What Success Looks Like**

* Consistently delivering high\-quality hires across India and MEA within timelines
* Building strong partnerships with hiring managers and regional stakeholders
* Demonstrating strong understanding of regional talent markets
* Creating a best\-in\-class candidate experience
* Contributing to a diverse and inclusive workforce

**ETAP requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. description:
**About the Opportunity**
=========================


Job Type: Permanent
Application Deadline: 11 July 2026 **Title: Early Careers Global Coordinator and Recruiter \- UK and India**

**Department:** **Early Careers Recruitment (HR \- CPO)**

**Location: Gurgaon, India**

  

We're proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years, to more than 2\.56 million customers globally. From more than 25 locations around the world, with $619 billion in total assets, we provide investment services and retirement expertise to everyone from central banks to private individuals. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our Early Careers Recruitment team and feel like you're part of something bigger.


Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. And across our organisation, we foster a welcoming, caring and inclusive culture where people feel respected, trusted and able to be themselves. We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more.

  



As a flexible employer, we trust our people to perform their role in the way that works best for them, our clients and our business. We are a disability\-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.

**About your team**


Early Careers Recruitment is part of the Chief People Office and works closely with business leaders, programme management, Talent Acquisition, HR and external partners to attract, assess and hire bright minds and diverse perspectives into Fidelity International. We recruit and engage future talent across graduate, intern, apprentice, insight and pipeline programmes, helping individuals take the first steps in their professional journeys while building the skills and potential our business needs for the future. In the UK, much of the work supports Investment Management early careers hiring; in India, the role will also support campus hiring for technology talent.


The team acts as a brand ambassador for Fidelity International and owns the candidate experience across early careers hiring. We combine relationship\-led attraction, inclusive assessment, data\-driven decision making and strong operational delivery to ensure our programmes are compelling, consistent, scalable and fair.

**About your role**


You will support early careers recruitment delivery across the UK and India, working closely with colleagues in both regions. Around 60% of the role will support UK early careers coordination and administration, with a focus on Investment Management, Distribution and FIL Platforms hiring. Around 40% will support India early careers hiring, primarily across technology roles, through campus recruitment delivery, university relationship management, candidate engagement and junior recruiter activity.


This role would suit someone who is highly organised, accurate, accountable and proactive, with strong English communication skills and the confidence to represent Fidelity International with candidates, universities and internal stakeholders. Working closely with Early Careers colleagues, HR, business stakeholders and external partners, you will:


UK Responsibilities:

* Support UK early careers recruitment coordination across graduate, intern, apprentice and pipeline programmes, including interview scheduling, assessment centre logistics, candidate communications, inbox management and tracker updates.
* Maintain accurate candidate, vacancy and process data in Oleeo and Workday, recruitment trackers and dashboards, supporting reporting, audit readiness and timely decision making.
* Support selection and assessment administration, including candidate progression, assessor communications, feedback collation, offer process support and joining handover.
* Coordinate candidate travel and expense processes for assessment centres, interviews and events, ensuring clear communication, accurate records and timely follow\-up.
* Support early careers onboarding administration, helping candidates and new joiners move smoothly from offer acceptance through to joining.

  

India responsibilities:

* Support India early careers hiring, primarily across technology roles, through role posting, candidate screening, shortlisting support, interview coordination, candidate management and follow\-up.
* Build and maintain productive relationships with selected universities, colleges, placement teams and student groups in India, supporting campus hiring plans and long\-term early careers talent pipelines.
* Play an active role in on\-campus recruitment events in India, coordinating interview days, assessment activity, candidate flow, stakeholder logistics and post\-event follow\-up.
* Help deliver a positive, inclusive and well\-organised experience for students, candidates, assessors and business stakeholders throughout the India campus hiring process..

  

Shared responsibilities:

* Coordinate and support early careers events, insight activities, campus engagement and virtual sessions, ensuring logistics, communications, materials and follow\-up actions are well managed.
* Support recruitment administration and operations activity, including process documentation, candidate checklists, purchase order or invoice support where required, and accurate records management.
* Work collaboratively with colleagues across the UK, India and wider global Early Careers team, contributing to consistent processes, shared ways of working and practical improvements.
* Manage high volumes of work during peak recruitment periods, prioritising effectively while maintaining accuracy, responsiveness and strong service standards.

**About you**

* You will have experience in recruitment coordination, HR coordination, talent acquisition operations or a similar role, ideally with exposure to early careers, campus hiring or high\-volume recruitment.
* You will be highly organised and conscientious, with excellent attention to detail, strong follow\-through and the ability to meet deadlines during busy periods.
* You will be accountable and proactive, taking ownership of your tasks and looking for ways to support colleagues and improve the candidate or stakeholder experience.
* You will have strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly, professionally and empathetically with candidates, colleagues and stakeholders across locations.
* You will be comfortable managing candidate queries and sensitive candidate interactions, showing patience, care and good judgement in your responses.
* You will be collaborative and team\-oriented, working closely with colleagues in both the UK and India.
* You will be comfortable building relationships with universities, colleges, placement teams, student groups and candidates, representing Fidelity International professionally in a campus environment.
* You will be comfortable using applicant tracking systems, recruitment trackers and Microsoft Office tools; experience supporting campus hiring, assessment centres, candidate screening, onboarding or offer administration would be useful..

 **Feel rewarded**


For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.


For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

**As an international financial services organisation, we are in\-scope of international regulations in the way that we carry out our work. This position is involved in work that is regulated by the FCA and/or the PRA and their Individual Conduct Rules (COCON) apply to it, along with any other regulation. We provide training on COCON and how it affects our employees. More information about COCON can be found in the Employment** **Handbook.**

 As we continue to scale, we are looking for an organized and execution\-focused HR Operations Executive who ensures every new employee has a seamless experience from offer acceptance through successful onboarding.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 The HR Operations Executive is responsible for managing all HR operational activities from the moment a candidate accepts an offer until they are successfully onboarded into the organization.
   

  

 This is an execution\-heavy role requiring exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple onboarding activities simultaneously.
   

  

 This role does
 **not** 
 handle recruitment or talent acquisition. Instead, it partners closely with the Recruitment team and HR Business Partner to ensure a smooth employee onboarding experience and maintain accurate HR records.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Pre\-Boarding

* Collect and verify all required employee documents.
* Track pending documentation and proactively follow up with candidates.
* Initiate and coordinate background verification.
* Prepare employee personnel files.
* Ensure all compliance documents are completed before joining.


 Onboarding
   

  

* Plan and execute end\-to\-end onboarding activities.
* Ensure Day\-1 readiness for every new employee.
* Coordinate laptop, system access, ID cards, email accounts, and required software.
* Schedule induction sessions and orientation programs.
* Facilitate completion of HR forms and policy acknowledgements.
* Conduct new hire documentation verification.
* Maintain onboarding checklists and completion status.


 HR Operations
   

  

* Maintain employee records and digital personnel files.
* Update and maintain HRMS with complete employee information.
* Manage probation confirmations and probation tracking.
* Issue employment letters and HR\-related documentation.
* Maintain leave and attendance records as required.
* Ensure employee information remains accurate and up to date.


 Compliance Administration
   

  

* Ensure statutory and company documentation is maintained.
* Maintain employee compliance records.
* Track document expirations and renewals where applicable.
* Support HR audits by maintaining organized documentation.
* Ensure adherence to internal HR policies and processes.


 Coordination
   

  

* Work closely with Recruitment, IT, Administration, Finance, and HRBP.
* Ensure cross\-functional readiness before every employee joining.
* Coordinate onboarding schedules across multiple departments.
* Track onboarding progress and resolve operational bottlenecks.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 0–2 years of experience in HR Operations or HR Administration.
* Fresh graduates with internship experience in HR are encouraged to apply.


**Required Skills**
* Excellent organizational skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Strong documentation and record management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Process\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience using HRMS platforms.
* Knowledge of employee lifecycle processes.
* Familiarity with onboarding and HR documentation.
* Basic understanding of Indian labor laws and HR compliance.
* Experience working in an IT Services or Technology organization is an advantage.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* 100% Day\-1 onboarding readiness for all new hires.
* 100% employee documentation completed before joining.
* 100% HRMS accuracy and timely updates.
* Zero onboarding delays caused by HR Operations.
* Background verification initiated within 24 hours of document completion.

title: Power2Her Associate
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

  

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

  

About the Programme


Power2Her is HSBC India Bank’s first\-ever formal returnship programme that enables promising women professionals to return to work after a career break. Launched in 2021, it is a key initiative to augment the potential of women colleagues looking to restart their career. It is also an opportunity to attract great talent and strengthen future leadership pipeline. This is a structured 6\-month journey to build the mindset and skills to integrate back into work. The participants will be entitled to a standard monthly stipend for the duration of the program. Power2Her (P2H) has played a pivotal role in infusing diversity at mid to junior levels within the bank. We have deployed 56% participants into full time roles across businesses and functions.


Who are we looking for?


If you are looking to return back to work and fulfil the criteria below then please apply by clicking the button below and send us your resume. If selected, we will be in contact within the next 2 weeks to confirm your participation and further details. If it is not for you, but you do know someone that could be interested then please do forward this on and ask them to apply!

* Minimum 5 years of professional full\-time experience
* Out of the workforce for a minimum of 6 months
* Open to opportunities for 6 months’ contract roles based in India
* Previous career history in one of the following areas: Wealth Management, Relationship Management, Service Orientation, Corporate Banking, Investment Banking, Business Banking, Trade Finance, Cash Management, Securities Services, Custody, Asset Management Sales/Service/Operations, Data Analytics, Compliance, Risk Management, Operations, Finance \& Accounting, Internal Audit, Legal, Strategy, Sales, Marketing, Technology, Business Support, Supply Chain and Procurement
* Eligible to work in India
* Must be available to attend all workshops and events related to the program


How will we support the returners?

* A well\-rounded 6 months Development Plan with structured interventions has been carefully designed to support the transition of returning candidates.
* The returners will be invited to join two curated workshops on ‘Reboot your Career \& Personal Brand’ and ‘Communicate with Confidence \& Empowered Accountability’ to support assimilate into our culture and be provided with a mentor to help navigate the eco\-system better.
* A sensitization workshop for Line Managers is organized to help create awareness on their role and aspired behaviors when managing this group.

  

Programme Features:

* P2H returners are hired across organization levels and do not have a Global Career Band
* P2H returners are hired basis business demand throughout the year
* P2H returners are entitled to 10 days Privilege Leaves that should be pre\-approved on email by the Line Manager during the 6\-month internship duration
* P2H returners are entitled to the Child\-care allowance as per policy (where required)
* P2H returners are encouraged to apply on all internal \& external jobs that are advertised basis relevance of skills from the day of joining
* P2H returners can be converted for a Full Time role on a real time basis if the returner has performed well and shows potential as per business hiring needs


Application \& Selection process for the Power2Her programme:

* To apply for the programme, please visit our website and apply
* Submit your profile by completing 7 self\-explanatory steps. Once the profile submission and e\-signature step is completed. A link to complete the psychometric assessment will appear. Please take your time to complete the assessment
* Profiles of candidates who have cleared the assessment will be shared with Hiring Managers for further evaluation
* Shortlisted candidates will be invited for interviews with respective business manager \& HR
* Pre\-Employment Vetting (PEV) checks will be initiated for the final selected candidate
* Employment contract for 6 months will be issued to the candidate with start \& end date post PEV checks completion which take about 2 weeks
* Induction invite will be sent with more details with the date of joining
* Experience Letter will be issued post 6 months’ program completion


Selection for Full time opportunities


Returners will be evaluated during the 6 months’ tenor. They will be evaluated for full\-time opportunities subject to performance and availability of suitable openings across businesses and functions. For more details on the programme, please reach out to rachna1\.mathur@hsbc.co.in


Reference Links


Testimonial Video Link: https://social.global.hsbc/umatube/videos/10673399

title: Senior HR Generalist
description:
**Who We Are**



Quickplay is a Content\-to\-Value Operating System for media and entertainment, connecting every stage of the content lifecycle—from ingest and enrichment to publishing and monetization—through a single, orchestrated AI system. We power video streaming for Tier\-1 operators, including Warner Bros. Discovery, TelevisaUnivision, Telekom Malaysia, Television New Zealand, and Gray Media.

  

Headquartered in Toronto with offices in Toronto, San Diego, and Chennai, Quickplay is the proven foundation that broadcasters, sports operators, streamers, and creators rely on to turn their catalog into revenue.

 **The Mission**



We are looking for you to drive new institutional capabilities and scale within our Chennai hub. This is one of the most leveraged roles on our People team—someone who will operate at the intersection of global talent strategy, local operational excellence, and organizational design. The role is intentionally split 50/50 between two halves: driving the future of our India operations and quarterbacking the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle for our Chennai team.

  

This is also an AI\-forward HR role. We don't want a traditional administrator; we expect this person to help us build out the People agent stack that handles the operational layer of HR—statutory compliance hygiene, documentation, data reporting, and foundational workflows—so that you and our leadership can spend your time on the work that actually moves the needle: talent judgment, high\-touch coaching, and cultural scaling. If you’re someone who sees AI as leverage rather than overhead and wants a hand in shaping how a modern, global HR org operates in India, you’ll have the autonomy to do that here.

 **What You’ll Own**



You will perform work with a high degree of latitude, handling complex issues and serving as the in\-country liaison. This is an individual contributor role. Your key responsibilities include:


* **HR Transformation \& AI:** Actively explore, implement, and leverage AI\-driven tools to streamline HR workflows, data analysis, and employee support. You are the custodian of a "frictionless" employee experience.
* **Strategic Global Collaboration:** Partner directly with the VP of People (located in North America) to bridge the gap between global strategy and local execution. You aren't just a link; you are the local expert who ensures our global initiatives land with impact. That includes proactively communicating and driving visibility.
* **Operational Excellence in the Fundational Stuff:** Own the foundational stuff \- from employee lifecycle for India, managing statutory reporting, and on\-the\-ground activities.
* **Local HR Partnership:** Provide consultative guidance and coaching to local managers and employees to ensure alignment with corporate policies and objectives. Partner with local vendors to bring meaningful educational experiences to Quickplayers.
* **Compliance \& Culture:** Provide consultative coaching to local managers to ensure our Chennai team remains high\-performing, inclusive, and deeply connected to Quickplay’s global culture, while giving oxygen to the local culture we want to amplify. Highly competitive Carrom tournaments are just the tip of the iceberg.

  


**Who You Are**

  

* **Experienced \& Context\-Aware:** You bring 8\-10 years of progressive experience, most recently as an HRBP or Senior Generalist, ideally in a high\-growth tech environment or in a global GCC.
* **An AI Experimenter:** You don't just use HRIS systems; you look for ways to optimize them. You are curious about how automation and LLMs can replace manual HR tasks. *Side Note:* We love Google and are a G Suite company.
* **A Cross\-Border Collaborator:** You are comfortable working across time zones, managing remote reporting lines, and driving strategic direction with minimal supervision.
* **High EQ / Low Ego:** You are a great teammate who understands that HR is about people, not just policies. You provide coaching that is both direct and empathetic.
* **Agile \& Autonomous:** You prioritize ruthlessly in fast\-paced environments and are comfortable "owning the room" when representing India’s interests to global leadership.

  


**Why Quickplay?**


* **High Leverage:** You aren't just a cog in the wheel; you are shaping the strategy for our entire India operation.
* **Innovation over Administration:** We encourage you to use AI and other creative avenues to make HR "smarter." If there’s a better, or more tech\-forward way to do it**,** bring your ideas to the table, and let’s try new things together.
* **Global Exposure:** Gain direct visibility with North American leadership, coordinate and drive global processes, while building a world\-class team in Chennai.

  


**Are you ready to build the future of HR at Quickplay? If you are a tech\-forward People pro who thrives on autonomy, let’s talk**

Flutter Entertainment is listed on both the **New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and the London Stock Exchange (LSE).** We’re proud to be recognized by **TIME** as one of the **World’s Best Companies 2025** — a reflection of the passion and commitment of our colleagues across the globe.
  

Our ambition is to transform global gaming and betting to deliver long\-term growth and a positive, sustainable future for our sector. Together, we are **Changing the Game** .


**FLUTTER ENTERTAINMENT INDIA**

Our office in the heart of **Hi\-Tech City** , Hyderabad, serves as **Flutter Entertainment’s Global Capability Center (GCC).** Now home to 1,000\+ talented colleagues, we are shaping the future of entertainment across critical areas such as Customer Support Operations, Data \& Technology, Business Operations (Finance, HR, Procurement), and HR Tech \& Analytics.


We are committed to crafting impactful solutions for all our brands and divisions to power Flutter's incredible growth and global impact. Our portfolio of **world\-class brands, global scale, and challenger mindset** presents a powerful combination.


We have ambitious growth plans and goals for the future and the **global and local scale to achieve them.**

**OVERVIEW OF THE ROLE**

The HR Operations Trainer is responsible for designing and delivering comprehensive training programs to enhance the capabilities of HR Operations, People Services, and related stakeholders. The role focuses on ensuring a consistent and high\-quality understanding of HR processes, policies, and systems across teams.


This position plays a critical role in driving operational excellence by continuously improving training content, methodologies, and learning effectiveness. It also supports compliance and process adherence through structured learning initiatives and effective knowledge management practices.


The HR Operations Trainer collaborates closely with cross\-functional teams to identify capability gaps and implement targeted training interventions. Additionally, the role is responsible for monitoring training effectiveness through assessments, feedback, and performance metrics, ensuring continuous improvement and an enhanced employee and stakeholder experience through accurate and timely HR operational knowledge.


**KEY RESPOBSIBILITIES**

**Training Design \& Delivery**

* Design, develop and deliver engaging training programs for HR Operations and People Services teams (new joiners and existing staff).
* Deliver training through a mix of formats including virtual sessions, classroom training, workshops, and self\-paced learning.
* Tailor content to different audiences, including HR Operations, managers, and wider business stakeholders where required.

**HR Process \& Systems**

* Train teams on end\-to\-end HR operational processes (employee lifecycle, case management, data management, background screening).
* Support training on HR systems and tools (HCM, case management platform, knowledge bases).
* Ensure training materials reflect current policies, procedures, and system updates.
* Continuous Improvement
* Partner with HR Operations leaders, SMEs, and Transformation teams to identify training needs and capability gaps.
* Continuously review and improve training content based on feedback, metrics, and operational changes.
* Support change initiatives by developing training aligned to new processes, systems, or ways of working.

**Knowledge management**

* Create and maintain training documents and learning materials.
* Contribute to HR Knowledge bases and ensure learning content remains accurate and up to date.
* Promote best practice and consistency across HR Operations globally or regionally.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work closely with Core HR and Transformation to align training with business priorities.
* Act as a trusted partner to leaders and managers on capability development within HR Operations.

**TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED TO HAVE**

**Essential**

* Proven experience in HR Operations, People Services or HR Shared Services.
* Experience designing and delivering training, ideally within an HR or operational environment.
* Strong understanding of HR processes and employee lifecycle activities.
* Excellent facilitation, communication, and presentation skills.
* Ability to translate complex processes into clear, practical learning content.

**Desirable**

* Experience supporting HR transformation or change initiatives.
* Exposure to global or regional HR operating models.
* Experience with HRIS platforms (Workday preferred, SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM) and case management tools.

**Qualifications:**

* Certification in Training \& Development, HR Operations, or Learning \& Development is an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of HR operations processes, policies, and compliance requirements.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office tools and Learning Management Systems (LMS).
* Ability to create training materials, SOPs, process documents, and assessments.

**Experience:**

* Typically, 3–7 years of experience in HR Operations, Shared Services, or HR Service Delivery.

* Hands\-on experience in areas such as:
* Employee lifecycle management
* HRIS systems
* Query handling and ticketing systems
* Experience in process improvement and quality initiatives is preferred.
* Exposure to global HR processes and stakeholder management is an advantage.
* Previous experience as a trainer, mentor, SME, or quality analyst is highly preferred.

**Measure of Success**

* Identify skill gaps through performance analysis and implement targeted coaching or refresher training programs.
* Support operational excellence by improving key performance indicators such as quality, productivity, SLA adherence, and customer/employee satisfaction.
* Partner effectively with Operations, Quality, and Process teams to enable continuous learning and capability development across the function.
